title: SE.OutlawsAndTheUndead
tags: ScriptedEvent
groupName: Outlaws And The Undead
position: 608,1249
---
// NOTES : above you will se SE.OutlawsAndTheUndead. this is the node name and is what is referenced in other nodes or in our game when we want to access this node
// it could be anything but i've been following the naming conventions
// "SE.Name" SE standing for scripted event
// "QUEST.Name" for quests
// "WE.Name" WE standing for world event like a war breaking out or something, More info in the google drive doc for World Events

// ADDITIONAL NOTES : also above you will see ScriptedEvent on a line by itself. this is a tag. Tags are parsed in code to determine what kind of node it is
// ScriptedEvent, DynamicDialogue, Quest, WorldEvent, Cutscenes (Cutscenes are the exact same as a scripted event in code except tagged differently because they will 
// be  our version of cutscenes where we will be showing dialogue between characters and having the ability to play sounds, animations, and more)

// one more note, on the node itself on the bottom right you will see a checkbox, this is if this node is enabled or not. if its disabled it will be skipped entirely in code

// this event is only called when entering a dungeon
//<<set $EventTrigger to "ON_DUNGEON_LOAD">>
// the higher priority ones will be shown first (not really needed here but leaving for example)
<<set $Priority to 2>>
// when will this event be available again to find (-1 is never)
<<set $DaysUntilRepeat to -1>>
// header of this event
<<set $EventTitle to "A Looming Darkness">>
// normally in dungeons we will get reactions from the party, some (like this one) however we don't want or need it
<<set $ReactionsEnabled to false>>
// as soon as this line of script is hit we will receive a quest that has the following node name
//<<AssignQuest Quest.OutlawsAndTheUndead>>
// this is the text that will show up in the body of the event
<<set $CheckForActiveQuest to "Quest.OutlawsAndTheUndead">>
**The smell of the sewer fills the air. Rotten and thick is the only way to describe it. It's unpleasant to be here for mere moments, how anybody could live down here seems impossible.**
->Let's hurry and find the amulet.
    <<stop>>
===
title: Quest.OutlawsAndTheUndead
tags: 
groupName: Outlaws And The Undead
position: 601,567
---
<<set $Tileset to "sewer">>
//<<set $Shrine to "ArlaTheGatekeeper">>
// these next 2 are what are shown when we look at the quest log or objective text on screen
<<set $QuestName to "A Looming Darkness">>
<<set $QuestDescription to "A local religious leader has employed your services to recover an ancient amulet, one that his family has guarded for generations. It contains powers of unspeakable evils that are only held at bay by the sacred grounds from which it was stolen. The thieves have a hideout within the sewers in town.">>
// this is the shortened version of the text used in places like the objective tracker mid dungeon
<<set $ShortDescription to "Recover the amulet before it's too late.">>
// this is where we tell the game what types of enemies will spawn in this dungeon
// can leave this alone for now. this is the only one currently in game
<<set $EnemyCategoryGroup to "UndeadMix">>
// how is this quest ultimately completed, this is where we'll have types of quests like boss fight, locate item, etc
// an "Open" quest means it will never automatically end from some objective. it will only be marked complete when something else tells it to be complete
// like calling CompleteQuest in a scripted event
<<set $QuestGoal to "Open">>
<<set $QuestItem to "Cursed Amulet of Aryk: You cannot yet comprehend its powers, but it is undeniably evil in nature. Perhaps with time you could unlock its potential.... :undeadAmulet:loot">> // name, description, image, type
<<set $QuestGiverLocation to "Citizen">>
<<set $QuestIntro to "A priest has a request for you.">>
<<set $IntroEvent to "SE.IntroToOutlawsAndTheUndead">>
<<set $QuestTurnInEventNode to "SE.OutlawsAndUndeadTurnIn">>
<<set $DungeonLocation to "IN_CITY">>
<<set $MinDaysBeforeRepeat to "1500">>
<<stop>>

// example of some other stuff we could set here

// this would generate a new item with some parameters (DisplayName, Description, Image, Type) seperated by a colon
// in order for this item to show up you'd have to play a lootable object in the map editor with it flagged to spawn a QuestItem
//<<set $QuestItem to "Trade Supplies:Recovered supplies:TradeSupplies0:loot">> // name, description, image, type

// this would play an event when we turned in the quest, like if you wanted some dialogue to play or something
//<<set $QuestTurnInEventNode to "SE.EndOfDemoQuest">>
<<set $Requirements to "">>
===
title: SE.OutlawsAndTheUndeadEnd
tags: ScriptedEvent
groupName: Outlaws And The Undead
position: 1019,1250
---
// this event has the trigger set to none which means it normally would never get called through other things that happen dynamically in game.
// it will however be triggered if called directly like from the level editor when we inspect a certain object on the map

// i copied the other demo quest here so you could see how to build out branching dialogue, TriggerEndOfDemo is what shows the splash screen
<<set $EventTrigger to "NONE">>
<<set $Priority to 1>>
<<set $DaysUntilRepeat to -1>>
<<set $EventTitle to "A Looming Darkness">>
<<set $ReactionsEnabled to false>>
<<SetPrimaryQuestObjectiveComplete>>
**With the thieves disposed of, you walk over to the leader's corpse, bending down to remove the stolen amulet from around his neck. Turning it over in your hands, you can feel a great power emanating from within.**

<<if getCharacterWithTrait("Greedy") == "true">> 
{
	{hasTrait:Greedy}I bet we could fetch a high price for that, likely more than the priest is offering.
}
<<endif>>

->Let's get out of here. **Leave**
    <<TriggerDungeonComplete true>>
    <<stop>>

->We should look around some more. **Stay**
    <<TriggerDungeonComplete false>> 
   	<<stop>>

title: Conv.BackstabberBoss
tags: Cutscene
groupName: Outlaws And The Undead
position: 1390,897
---
<<set $Icon to "Boss">>
<<ShowParty>>
<<set $ReactionsEnabled to false>>
<<AddNpc OutlawEnforcer false>>
<<AddNpc OutlawBackstabber true>>
<<SetSpeaker [npc1]>>
<<CacheQuest Quest.OutlawsAndTheUndead>>
**You enter a large room, the stench of death filling the air. The leader of the outlaws stands before you, covered with blood and standing in what appears to be a summoning circle.**
{npc:outlawsUndeadNpcBoss}You know, I intended to sell this amulet, but your presence and meddling has made me realize its true power. It's worth is beyond any amount of coin.
**He turns and steps behind one of his men, unsheathing his dagger.**
{npc:outlawsUndeadNpcBoss}All that's needed is a sacrifice...
->**Continue**
    <<SetAnimTrigger [npc1] Attack0 0>>
    <<AddPause 0.3>>
    <<SetAnimTrigger [npc0] IsDead 1>>
    <<AddNpc Skeleton true>>
    <<AddNpc SkeletonArcher true>>
    **He kneels down over the dead man, scraping his dagger against the body to remove the blood.**
    {npc:outlawsUndeadNpcBoss}I'll have an army at my command in a fortnight and the world be powerless to stop me! 
    **He rises and clutches the glowing amulet around his neck, raising his other hand in your direction**
    {npc:outlawsUndeadNpcBoss}Minions, spill their blood across these halls! We've work to do!
    ->Time to put an end to this madness. **Fight**
        <<SetBattleMusic BossTheme>>
        <<SetPostBattleEvent SE.OutlawsAndTheUndeadEnd>>
        <<AddLootToNextBattle "Cursed Amulet of Aryk">>
        <<stop>>

title: SE.IntroToOutlawsAndTheUndead
tags: ScriptedEvent
groupName: Outlaws And The Undead
position: 601,915
---
<<set $EventTrigger to "NONE">>
// header of this event
<<set $EventTitle to "A Looming Darkness">>
<<set $ReactionsEnabled to false>>
<<CreateNpc "id:QGoutlawsUndeadNpc,name:Father Rham,img:OldPriest">>
// this is the text that will show up in the body of the event
**You enter a small Church, while it appears run down, there are many patrons milling about. The head priest approaches you.**
{npc:QGoutlawsUndeadNpc}I can tell you aren't here to pray.
->I hear you've got work.
    {npc:QGoutlawsUndeadNpc}Quite right. For generations my family has guarded a sacred amulet of great evil. Only by housing it in a holy place can its power be kept in check. I regret that I have failed my duty and a week ago it was stolen. Unless its returned, I fear it will be used for some nefarious purpose.
    ->Do you know anything about the thieves?
        {npc:QGoutlawsUndeadNpc}It just so happens my son saw them as they were leaving. He followed them to what appeared to be their hideout. They are living in the sewer of all places! I'll point you in the right direction.
        ->Thanks. We'll be on our way.
            <<AssignQuest Quest.OutlawsAndTheUndead>>
            <<stop>>
    ->This sounds outside my realm of expertise. **Decline quest**
        {npc:QGoutlawsUndeadNpc}I understand. I hope we find some help before it is too late.
        ->**Exit**
            <<DeclineQuest Quest.OutlawsAndTheUndead>>
            <<stop>>
===
title: SE.Trap.PitTrap0
tags: 
groupName: Dynamic Exploration Events
position: 1856,3426
---
<<set $Icon to "Hazard">>
<<set $TriggerTags to "generic">>
<<set $Requirements to "Trap">>
<<InitTrap>>
<<if doPartyPerceptionCheck() is "true">>
{
    **You notice a stone block on the ground that doesn't match the surroundings. It looks out of place and doesn't belong. Upon further examination, it seems to be some sort of trap.**
    ->[Disarm:Dex,Time:3]**Attempt to disable the mechanism that triggers the trap.**
        <<DisarmTrap>>
        <<if $TrapDisarmed>>
            <<DisarmSuccess>>
            **You manage to disable the mechanism being used to create the trap.**
            ->**Continue**
                <<stop>> 
        <<else>>
            <<PlaySound LargeRocksFallingQuick>>
            <<DisarmFailed>>
            **You're attempt at disarming it has proven disastrous. The floor collapses underneath your party. Everyone falls, taking some damage.**
            ->**Climb back up and continue on your way.**
                <<stop>> 
        <<endif>>
    ->[DodgeTrap:Dex]Some rube really thought they would get us with this weak nonsense? Come on guys, don't step on this obvious trap, and let's keep going.
        <<DodgeTrap>>
        <<if $TrapDodged>>
            **Everyone has a hearty chuckle and they carefully step around any out of place stones on the ground.**
            ->Let's continue onward.
                <<stop>>
        <<else>>
            **Everyone has a hearty chuckle and takes a step around the trap only to have missed the one right behind it.**
            <<PlaySound LargeRocksFallingQuick>>
            <<TriggerTrap>>
            **The floor collapses underneath your party. Everyone falls, taking some damage.**
            ->**Climb back up and continue on your way.**
                <<stop>>
        <<endif>>
}
<<else>>
{
    **The floor shifts as someone has stepped on something they shouldn't have before collapsing underneath your feet. Everyone falls, taking some damage in the process.**
    <<PlaySound LargeRocksFallingQuick>>
    <<TriggerTrap>>
    ->**Climb back up and continue on your way.**
        <<stop>>
}
<<endif>>
===
title: SE.Trap.PitTrap1
tags: 
groupName: Random Traps
position: 1001,511
---
<<set $Icon to "Hazard">>
<<set $EventTrigger to "NONE">>
<<set $Priority to 1>>
<<set $DaysUntilRepeat to 100>>
<<set $EventTitle to "Event">>
<<set $ReactionsEnabled to false>>
<<set $Requirements to "Trap:PitTrap easy 1">>
<<InitTrap singleTarget>>
[TrapTarget] takes a step into the room and hears a 'click' noise under their feet and immediately stops moving.
->[DodgeTrap:1,FocusCost:Low,Stat:DEX]Try to jump backwards to dodge whatever trap you have triggered.
    <<DodgeTrap>>
    <<if $TrapDodged>>
    [TrapTarget] narrowly escapes danger by leaping backwards just as the floor collapses revealing a pit.
    <<else>>
    <<TriggerTrap>>
    [TrapTarget] failed to react in time and fell into a pit taking some damage.
    <<PlaySound SliceBodyImpact>>
    <<endif>>
    ->Continue
        <<stop>>
->[Disarm:2,Stat:DEX]Stay still and attempt to disarm whatever trap lies below.
    <<DisarmTrap>>
    <<if $TrapDisarmed>>
    [TrapTarget] manages to disable the mechanism being used to create the trap.
    <<else>>
    <<TriggerTrap>>
    <<PlaySound SliceBodyImpact>>
    [TrapTarget]'s attempts to disarm the trap have failed and the floor collapses underneath them. They fall and takes some damage.
    <<endif>>
    ->Exit
        <<stop>>
->Continue on as if nothing is amiss.
    <<TriggerTrap true>>
    The floor collapses underneath [TrapTarget] and they fall taking some damage.
    <<PlaySound SliceBodyImpact>>
    ->Continue
        <<stop>>

title: nodeIntroAtAnyCost4
tags: 
groupName: At Any Cost
position: 1927,528
---
{npc:atAnyCostNpcQG}Fair enough, good bye.
[The nobleman slinks off in the direction he came from. He seems less than pleased you couldn't make a deal.]
    ->**Follow him.**
        **You follow him back to what appears to be his house. He resides in a very wealthy district where all the manors are adorned with decorations the common-folk couldn't afford in a years salary. You should be quick about our business, lest you gain too much attention. You notice the window on the second story is open.**
        ->**Climb up and enter the window.**
            **After rummaging through some rooms you discover a journal seemingly from the man you met earlier.**
            ->**Read journal.**
                **You read the last entry.**
                "This town is ill prepared for an attack. Why just last week a bear got loose in the city and mauled a child to death! The city guards are far too lax in their duties. I wish the people could see what's out there in the real world."
                ->**Continue**
                    **You find a scroll capable of binding and releasing an undead creature as well as a scroll to banish one. It's possible his intention was for you to capture some creature and then he would play the hero after letting it run wild for a bit.**
                    ->**Take all the evidence you found to the city guards.**
                        **You take your findings to the city guards. They seem less than shocked at your accusations as if perhaps they had past dealings with this person. They thank you for the tip and reward you for your troubles.**
                        ->**Complete quest.**
                            <<AssignQuest Quest.AtAnyCost>>
                            <<ModifyQuestRewards Quest.AtAnyCost "xp:50,gold:500">>
                            <<CompleteQuest Quest.AtAnyCost>>
                            <<stop>>
                    ->**Modify the banishment scroll, rendering it useless and leave.**
                        **You make subtle changes to the scroll that probably make it unusable.**
                        ->**Exit the window and knock on the door.**
                            **The same noble you spoke with earlier opens the door with a shocked look on his face.**
                            {npc:atAnyCostNpcQG}What are you doing here? How did you find me?
                            [[I've changed my mind, I'll assist you.|nodeIntroAtAnyCost6]]
                        ->**Leave (Decline quest)**
                            <<DeclineQuest Quest.AtAnyCost>>
                            <<stop>>
        ->**Leave (Decline quest)**
            <<DeclineQuest Quest.AtAnyCost>>
            <<stop>>
    ->**Leave (Decline quest)**
        <<DeclineQuest Quest.AtAnyCost>> 
        <<stop>>

title: Conv.AtAnyCostBossCutScene
tags: Cutscene
groupName: At Any Cost
position: 3219,1089
---
<<ShowParty>>
<<set $ReactionsEnabled to false>>
<<AddNpc Skeleton false>>
<<SetSpeaker [player0]>>
[You've found the wight you were searching for and immediately produce the capturing scroll from your satchel.
->[Action:Use the scroll]
    [As you read the contents aloud, a light envelopes the wight and he is pulled into the scroll.]
    <<PlayEffect SmokeBomb [npc0] false>>
    <<RemoveItem "Scroll Of Capturing">>
    <<CreateItem "Scroll Of Capturing (Wight)" quest scroll "A scroll infused with a magic that allows the capture of a specific creature. The scroll now contains a Wight within it.">>
    <<GiveItem "Scroll Of Capturing (Wight)">>
    <<RemoveNpc 0>>
    ->[Action:Continue]
        [Just then, a horde of foul beasts, seemingly drawn to your magic, emerge and begin to attack.]
        <<AddNpc RisenScourge true>>
        <<AddNpc Skeleton true>>
        <<AddNpc Skeleton true>>
        <<AddNpc SkeletonArcher true>>
        <<AddNpc SkeletonArcher true>>
        ->[Action:Prepare for combat]
            <<SetBattleMusic BossTheme>>
            <<SetPostBattleEvent SE.AtAnyCostEndOfWightCapture>>
            <<stop>>

title: SE.AtAnyCostEpilogue2
tags: ScriptedEvent
groupName: At Any Cost
position: 2846,1472
---
<<set $EventTrigger to "TRAVELING_ON_WORLD_MAP">>
<<set $QuestName to "Quest.AtAnyCost">>
<<set $Priority to 1>>
<<set $DaysUntilRepeat to -1>>
<<set $EventTitle to "Report">>
<<set $IsEnabled to false>>

title: SE.SafeguardingAShipmentRoadAttack
tags: ScriptedEvent
groupName: Safeguarding A Shipment
position: 142,5
---
// this event is only called when traveling on the world map
<<set $EventTrigger to "TRAVELING_ON_WORLD_MAP">>
<<set $DaysUntilRepeat to -1>>
<<set $CheckForActiveQuest to "Quest.SafeguardingAShipment" >>
<<set $Priority to 99>>
//TODO: this gold value for the bribe needs to dynamically be double of whatever the quest reward is
**You are riding along when suddenly you hear several war cries from over a nearby ridge, followed closely by the sound of loosing arrows - one narrowly missing you.**
{advisor}[myTitle], it's an ambush!
{npc:safeguardNpc}Those damned bastards must have followed us out of [questTown]! Good thing I hired you, eh?
<<if getRandomChance(50) is "true">>
{
    ->To arms! **Fight**
        <<ShowPartyOnRegionTileset SE.SafeguardingAShipmentRoadAttackCombat>>
        <<stop>>
}
<<else>> 
{
    **One of the bandits steps forward and signals for his allies to hold position.**
    <<CreateNpc "id:tempNpc,name:Man,img:OldPriest">>
    {npc:tempNpc}Now there's no need for this to get bloody! **He points towards your employer's tradecart.** We just want what you've got in that fancy cart over there. How about we make ourselves a deal?
    ->[Honorable,Brave]Not a chance, you'll have to take it yourselves! **Fight**
        <<ShowPartyOnRegionTileset SE.SafeguardingAShipmentRoadAttackCombat>>
        <<stop>> 
    ->What do you have in mind? 
        **The trader shuffles beside you and grabs hold of your arm.**
        {npc:safeguardNpc}Don't get any ideas, now. Scum like this can't be trusted, and I've promised you fair pay.
        **A crooked smile creeps across the bandit's face.**
        {npc:tempNpc}Hah, I knew you'd be curious. Just so happens that I'm in a generous mood, so we'll pay double on whatever's owed to you. The cart's worth far more, anyway. Just take the coin and move yourselves along. Simple enough, ain't it? 
        ->[Greedy,Treacherous]Very well. We accept your offer. **Abandon Contract**
            <<AddCitizenToGuildOpinion closest -30>>
            {npc:tempNpc}A person of reason, uh? **He hands you a sack of coins.** Glad we could do business.
            <<ModifyGold "questRewardMult:2">>
            {npc:safeguardNpc}You can't do this, we had a deal! You'll all pay for---
            **His protest is cut short as one of the bandits plunges a knife into his chest. He drops to the ground, clawing at the air as blood gurgles from his mouth.**
            {npc:tempNpc}Can't have him spreading word of this now, can we? Now move on, and leave that cart where it is.
            ->**Continue**
                <<FailQuest "Quest.SafeguardingAShipment">>
                <<stop>>
        ->[Greedy,Treacherous]Not enough. Better make it triple. 
            {npc:tempNpc}Triple, uh? **He laughs and looks back towards his allies who are sporting a grin of their own.** Well, I can respect your position, but I'm afraid we can't do that. **He draws his weapon and signals to his crew.** Looks like we'll have to settle this with blood!
            ->**Fight**
                <<ShowPartyOnRegionTileset SE.SafeguardingAShipmentRoadAttackCombat>>
                <<stop>> 
        ->[Honorable,Brave]Forget it. You'll have to fight us for it. **Fight**
            <<ShowPartyOnRegionTileset SE.SafeguardingAShipmentRoadAttackCombat>>
            <<stop>> 
}
<<endif>>

title: SE.ClearingACreatureDenHusbandFound

groupName: Clearing A Creature Den

---
<<set $Icon to "Boss">>
<<SetEventFinished>>
<<if getRandomChance(35) is "true">>
{
    <<ModifyQuestVar "Quest.ClearingACreatureDen" "HusbandAlive" "false">>
    **Up ahead you spot the silhouette of a body slumped in a recess along the cave's wall. You cautiously approach and call out to them, but there is no response.**
    {player:0}I'm guessing that's her husband. Doesn't look like he's moving.
    **As you get closer, deep slashes on his body and pools of blood become clearly visible.**
    **[FNameP0] kneels down to check for any sign of life. They look back towards you and shake their head.**
    {player:0}He's been dead for some time, I don't think there was much we could have done.
    <<if getCharacterWithTrait("Greedy") is "true">>
    {
        **[$CharacterWithTraitName] nudges their foot against the deceased's weapon, still clutched in his hand.** 
        {player:$CharacterWithTrait}Looks like he has some valuables on him, though. **They raise their hands, as if being judged by everyone.** What? I'm only making an observation.
    }
    <<else>> 
    {
        **[FNameP0] nudges their foot against the deceased's weapon, still clutched in his hand.**
        {player:0}Fancy weapon for a farmer. A shame it didn't serve him better.
    }
    <<endif>> 
    ->[Honorable,Content]The body will be returned along with its possessions. We're not here to rob the dead.
        <<if getCharacterWithTrait("Honorable") is "true">>
        {
            **[$CharacterWithTraitName] nods in approval.** 
            {player:$CharacterWithTrait}Well said, boss. That stuff belongs to the wife; there's no honor in thievery.
        }
        <<endif>>
        **No one protests the decision. You carefully wrap the body up for transport and place the man's possessions in your bags, intent on returning them to your employer.**
        ->**Continue**
            [[node.ClearingACreatureDenFoundBoss]]
    ->[Greedy,Treacherous]Take what you can. She's only expecting the body to be returned.
        <<GiveWeaponByType "sword">>
        <<ModifyQuestVar "Quest.ClearingACreatureDen" "StealFromBody" "true">>
        **After pocketing the items, you carefully wrap the body up for transport and continue onward.**
        ->**Continue**
            [[node.ClearingACreatureDenFoundBoss]]
}
<< else >> 
{
    <<ModifyQuestVar "Quest.ClearingACreatureDen" "HusbandAlive" "true">>
    <<CreateNpc "id:CreatureDenNpcHusband,name:Missing Husband,img:OldPriest">>
    **As you round a bend, you hear a rustling up ahead. You raise your torch to find a man scrambling for his weapon, groaning through the effort. His panic subsides as he realizes you're not one of those creatures, and he calls out to you.**
    {npc:CreatureDenNpcHusband}Hello? Have you come from [questTown]? Did my wife send you? **He tries to stand, but every part of his body protests and he falls back to the ground with a whimper.**
    ->She did. Looks like we've found you just in time.
        **The man looks down at his wounds and chuckles, immediately followed by a wince of pain.**
        {npc:CreatureDenNpcHusband}I reckon you're right. Leg's broken, I think. Probably more than that too. I can't go anywhere on my own, that's for sure. Hah! Some fool I am, thinking I could best these creatures. **He sighs.** Do you think you could help me out?
        <<if getCharacterWithTrait("Harsh") is "true">>
        {
            **[$CharacterWithTraitName] leans in beside you and whispers to avoid being overheard.** 
            {player:$CharacterWithTrait}He'll slow us down, boss. Not sure if it's a good idea with creatures still about.
        }
        <<endif>> 
        ->[Time:2,RemoveRequiredItem:tio_bandage,Merciful,Honorable]We should tend to those wounds first. **Bandage his wounds**
            <<AddCitizenToGuildOpinion closest 10>>
            **Relief washes over the man's face. [FNameP0] steps toward him and begins to dress his wounds as best they can.** 
            {player:0}That oughta do it. Best I can do for now, anyway. [FNameP0] stands up and offers out their hand for the man to grab, gently pulling him upright. With an arm slung around [FNameP0], the man gives you a subtle nod, ready to move out.
            ->**Continue**
                [[node.ClearingACreatureDenFoundBoss]]
        ->[Honorable,Merciful]Of course. Let's get you home.
            <<AddCitizenToGuildOpinion closest 5>>
            **Relief washes over the man's face. [FNameP0] steps toward him and offers out their hand to grab, gently pulling the man upright. With an arm slung around [FNameP0], the man gives you a subtle nod, ready to move out.**
            ->**Continue**
                [[node.ClearingACreatureDenFoundBoss]]
        ->[Harsh]You'll be a burden on my crew if we get in another fight. You better make it worth it for us.
            <<if getCharacterWithTrait("Honorable,Merciful") is "true">>
            {
                **[$CharacterWithTraitName] looks at you with accusing eyes and interjects in protest.**
                {player:$CharacterWithTrait}Well we can't just leave him here. That wouldn't sit right with me.
            }
            << endif >> 
            **The wounded man seems taken aback and hesitates to formulate a response.**
            {npc:CreatureDenNpcHusband}Well, I uh... suppose you can have my weapon. I'm afraid that's the best I can offer, though. Whatever my wife promised you as reward is likely all else we have. 
            ->[Treacherous,Greedy]That will do. Let's move out, then.
                <<AddCitizenToGuildOpinion closest -10>>
                **You nod to [FNameP0] who steps forward and offers their hand for the man to grab, gently pulling him upright.**
                <<GiveWeaponByType "sword">>
                <<ModifyQuestVar "Quest.ClearingACreatureDen" "StealFromBody" "true">>
                ->**Continue**
                    [[node.ClearingACreatureDenFoundBoss]]

                <<if getCharacterWithTrait("Honorable,Merciful") is "true">>
                {
                    **[$CharacterWithTraitName] puts a hand on your shoulder and meets your eye with an approving nod.**
                    {player:$CharacterWithTrait}Let's help him up then, shall we?
                }
                << endif >> 
                **Relief washes over the man's face. [FNameP0] steps toward him and offers out their hand to grab, gently pulling the man upright. With an arm slung around [FNameP0], the man gives you a subtle nod, ready to move out.**
                ->**Continue**
                    [[node.ClearingACreatureDenFoundBoss]]

title: SE.BanditsEliminateBoss
tags: ScriptedEvent
groupName: Bandit Activity
position: 440,1353
---
<<set $Icon to "Boss">>
<<CreateNpc "id:tempNpc,name:Bandit Leader,img:OldPriest">>
**As you move through the cavern, you come to an open chamber to find a row of bandits ready and waiting for you. One of them steps forward, their sharpened blade raised.**
<<SetEventFinished>>
<<set $BanditsEliminateLie to false>>
<<if getRandomChance(40) is "true">>
{
    {npc:tempNpc}You're certainly skilled fighters, but I've killed better. You lot will be no different!
    ->To arms! **Fight**
        <<ShowParty>>
        <<CreateBossEncounter>>
        <<SetBattleMusic BossTheme>>
        <<stop>>
}
<<else>> 
{
    {npc:tempNpc}You're certainly skilled fighters. **He scratches at his chin, head tilting to one side.** Tell you what - instead of us killing each other right here, how about we make ourselves a deal? 
    ->[Honorable,Brave]We've come to do a job, and you deserve no less than death. **Attack**
        <<ShowParty>>
        <<CreateBossEncounter>>
        <<SetBattleMusic BossTheme>>
        <<stop>> 
    ->What are you proposing? 
        <<if getCharacterWithTrait("Honorable") is "true">>
        {
            **[$CharacterWithTraitName] shuffles beside you, whispering in your ear.**
            {player:$CharacterWithTrait}We can't trust a thing they say, boss. And besides, we can't be going against our word. 
        }
        <<elseif getCharacterWithTrait("Cowardly") is "true">>
        {
            **[$CharacterWithTraitName] shuffles beside you, whispering in your ear.**
            {player:$CharacterWithTrait}Anything we can do to avoid fighting is fine by me, boss. 
        }
        <<endif>>
        **A crooked smile creeps across the bandit's face.**
        {npc:tempNpc}I assume you're getting paid well for this, no? What I propose is this: let us go, and we'll move on to a new city. You can tell your employer whatever you'd like. I'll even throw in a few coins to sweeten the deal.  
        ->[Greedy,Treacherous]Very well. We accept your offer. 
            {npc:tempNpc}I knew you couldn't resist. **He hands you a sack of coins.** Glad we could do business.
            <<ModifyGold "questRewardMult:0.25">>
            {npc:tempNpc}We'll be leaving, then. Tell your employer we've been dealt with if it makes you feel any better.
            ->**Continue**
                <<ModifyGlobalVar $BanditsEliminateLie "true">>
                [[SE.BanditsEliminateGoalMet]]
        ->[Honorable,Brave]Forget it. You deserve no mercy. **Attack**
            <<ShowParty>>
            <<CreateBossEncounter>>
            <<SetBattleMusic BossTheme>>
            <<stop>> 
}
<<endif>>

===
title: SE.UniqueEventNecromancerPrisoner
tags: 
groupName: Dynamic Exploration Events
position: 1598,4558
---
// this event only occurs in a dungeon with a necromancer boss
// rare event, doesnt happen first time. won't repeat ever if you trigger it
// you will discover a boy (around the age 14 or so). he will tell you he was taken here and has been experimented on by the necromancer.
// the boy is trapped in some magical field and is unable to be rescued.
// the way to save him will be after defeating an elite mob encounter elsewhere in the dungeon you will find in the room an artifact that can be used on the the kids cage to free him
// conversely you can keep the item and sell it for a very high value but the kid will die

// work needed to support this. 
// 1. function to add scripted event to random tile somewhere in the dungeon (probably another optional non story tile). if none exist then random unexplored tile
// 2. make sure i have a way for a special recruit to join you later with this boys story once he turns 18



// below is a different event, just using it as an example to pull from as a template
<<set $Icon to "Npc">>
<<set $TriggerTags to "creatures">>
<<set $Tileset to "cave,crypt">>
<<CreateNpc "id:tempNpc,name:Injured Man,img:maleCivilian">>
**You round a corner and sitting there, slumped against the wall, is a young man. He looks barely conscious. Blood pools around him from a wound in his gut.**
{npc:tempNpc}Thank Tian you found me. I was attacked by some beast... somehow I managed to get away. Please, help me.
->[RemoveRequiredItem:tio_bandage,Honorable]Here, we'll wrap your wound with bandages.
    {npc:tempNpc}Thank you so much. I don't have much on me but I owe you my life so you can take everything I found.
    <<GiveItem>>
    <<GiveItem>>
    {npc:tempNpc}I'll be on my way now. I'm getting out of here.
    ->**Continue**
->[Harsh,Greedy]Let's kill him and take his belongings. He's not long for this world anyway.
    <<if getCharacterWithOppositeOfTrait("Harsh,Greedy") == "true">> 
    {
        {hasTrait:Merciful,Content}Wait, no! Stop!

->Where did these Blighted come from? 
{npc:campaignCommanderOwaynNpc}As you may know, the city of Wealden was lost to the Scourge many decades ago. The dragon struck during a harsh winter. One of the worst ever, in fact. **He pauses in reflection, heaving out a great sigh.**
{npc:campaignCommanderOwaynNpc}The majority of the city turned Blighted, and those who hadn't either died at their hands, or died in the freezing snows trying to reach safety...to reach us. We can't say for certain how many Blighted remain up north. But judging by today's attack, it is likely no small number. 
->About that job...
{npc:campaignCommanderOwaynNpc}As I was saying earlier, it is a dangerous one. We intend to venture north in an effort to eliminate all the Blighted and reclaim what remains of Wealden in the process. We are holding out hope that some survivors can be found, though it seems unlikely. Given what's happened here, however, we will need some additional time to prepare. I do have another task for you in the meantime, if you're up for it.
->What is it?
{npc:campaignCommanderOwaynNpc}We often send out scouting parties to track the movements of the Blighted. They haven't returned yet, which is why this particular attack caught us by surprise. At this point, I am fearing the worst. But I need to be sure of their fates, and to give them a proper funeral if possible.
->Any idea where to start looking? 
{npc:campaignCommanderOwaynNpc}I'll mark it on your map. Their trail shouldn't be too hard to pick up in the snow. Few travel this far north, aside from the Blighted and the nomads.

title: node.VanguardFactionWealdenCampaignQuery
tags: 
groupName: CampaignFortVanguard
position: 656,571
---
{npc:campaignCommanderOwaynNpc}Sadly, the state of our Order does not live up to its rich history. Young men and women nowadays would sooner fight in the wars of humanity than join the Vanguard. And who can blame them? Man is not so fierce an opponent compared to demons and Blighted. **He gives a grim snort.** And above all, the nobles of Caelum pay far better for one's service.
**Owayn pauses, a weary look of resignation upon his face.** 
{npc:campaignCommanderOwaynNpc}To put it plainly, our Order has lacked the manpower. Were it not for the serum and our employ of Blighted, we would struggle to effectively protect the realm. There's a twisted irony in that, I suppose.

<<set $EventTrigger to "ON_WORLD_MAP_LOAD">>
<<set $CheckForActiveQuest to "[TurnIn]Quest.CampaignBlightedAssault">>
<<set $DaysUntilRepeat to -1>>
<<RemoveTempAlliesFromThisQuest>>
<<if $temp is "true">>
{
    **The chorus of ringing steel dies down as the last of the Blighted are driven off or put down. You frown out across the snowy plains--blood and bodies everywhere--and exhale with relief that it's over. Easing through a loose crowd of soldiers, Owayn makes his way over to your position, his grey beard spattered with specks of dark blood.** 
    {npc:campaignCommanderOwaynNpc}We've not seen the last of them. **His head swivels around, glimpsing the carnage.** Damned wretches are always wandering down here, though not usually in that great a number. 
    **Owayn extends his gauntleted hand and you grasp it in a firm shake.**
    {npc:campaignCommanderOwaynNpc}Your help is appreciated. **He glances around at your companions.** You certainly handle yourselves well.
    <<CompleteQuest Quest.CampaignBlightedAssault>> 
}
<<else>>
{
    **With your losses mounting, you signal the rest of your company to fall back to safety. You look on as the fighting continues, and despite the breakdown in formation, the Vanguard manages to fend off the assault - the last of the Blighted being driven off or put down. You frown out across the snowy plains - blood and bodies everywhere - and hang your head at your own failings.** 
    **[FNameP0] drifts up behind you, heaving out a sigh and staring out across the battlefield.**
    {player:0}We should retrieve their bodies; they deserve a proper funeral. **[FNameP0] sets off out into the fields, turning back to you momentarily.** Don't be too hard on yourself, boss. They all knew the risks. 
    **You give a solemn nod and turn to see Owayn easing through a loose crowd of soldiers and making way to your position, his grey beard spattered with specks of dark blood.** 
    {npc:campaignCommanderOwaynNpc}I'm sorry for your losses. I know the feeling all too well, unfortunately. Such is the burden of command. **He exhales, gazing out into the snowy pasture.** 
    {npc:campaignCommanderOwaynNpc}We've not seen the last of them. Damned wretches are always wandering down here, though not usually in that great a number.
    <<CompleteQuest Quest.CampaignBlightedAssault>> 
}
<<endif>>

===
title: SE.CompanyManIntroduction
tags: ScriptedEvent
groupName: Company Work
position: -202,-709
---
<<CreateNpc "id:companyManNpc,name:Brunshure,img:npc_male_friendly">>
**You are greeted by a large man, his long flowing cape bearing the crest of his House. Judging by the numerous guards escorting him, he is seemingly a man of some importance.**
{npc:companyManNpc}Well, well, well. I finally get to meet the leader of the great [CompanyName]. I've heard so much about you.
->Indeed? I'm afraid I can't say the same for you.
**The man steps back and chuckles, placing a hand over his chest.**
{npc:companyManNpc}You wound me! But fortunately for you, I take no offense! My name is Trechon Brunshure, and I have the unfortunate responsibility of overseeing the local iron mines for our liege. The mine's been in my family for generations, and I promised my father it would stay that way.
**He pauses for a breath, his face reddening.**
{npc:companyManNpc}But I find myself in a predicament, as the damned miners have altogether stopped working! I had sent a man to deal with the problem, but the only thing he succeeded in was getting himself killed. They sent me his head of all things! A threat if I've ever seen one!
->Sounds like a problem.
{npc:companyManNpc}If I'm honest, I never liked the man, so his death is of little concern. Still, the actions of these mutineers cannot go unpunished!
->What is it you want us to do?
{npc:companyManNpc}It seems that the miners are unhappy with their working conditions and how much I'm paying them. They don't understand the work I do for them! They should be grateful that I'm allowing them the opportunity to even work for me! They are refusing to work! I need you to get them in line, using any means necessary!
<<if getCharacterWithTrait("Honorable") is "true">> 
{
    **[$CharacterWithTraitName] pulls you aside with a look of concern on [pronounPoss[$CharacterWithAttribute]] face.**
    {player:$CharacterWithTrait}This doesn't feel right, boss. I'd sooner help the miners than serve this man.
}
<<endif>>
**[FNameAdvisor] leans in, his voice low.**
{advisor}A job like this may yield a lot of coin, but I question the morality of it. I suspect many of our troops would prefer not to work for this man no matter the reward.
**{npcName:companyManNpc} clears his throat to get your attention.**
{npc:companyManNpc}Rest assured, you'll be well-compensated for dealing with them, and my liege will be sure to hear of your service! I just need this ordeal to end so I can get back to more important matters.
->We'll take the job and investigate what's going on over there. **Accept contract**
    <<AssignQuest Quest.CompanyMan>>
->We'll talk with them, but we won't spill their blood. **Investigate the miner's plight**  
    <<AssignQuest Quest.CompanyMan>>
    <<CompleteQuest Quest.CompanyMan "skipTurnInEvent,skipResults">>
    <<AssignQuest Quest.CompanyManRevolt>>
->This matter does not interest us. **Decline contract**
    <<DeclineQuest Quest.CompanyMan>>
    <<stop>>

===
title: SE.CompanyManArriveAtDestination
tags: ScriptedEvent
groupName: Company Work
position: -197,-157
---
<<set $EventTrigger to "ON_QUEST_DESTINATION_ARRIVAL">>
<<set $CheckForActiveQuest to "Quest.CompanyMan" >>
<<CreateNpc "id:companyManMiner,name:Francia,img:npc_female_friendly">>
<<RemoveEventFromFutureUse SE.CompanyManArriveAtDestination>>
**You arrive at the mine, a group of ragged-looking workers standing at the entrance with weapons gripped tight. A woman emerges through their ranks with a scowl on her face.**
{npc:companyManMiner}And just who are you? {npcName:companyManNpc}'s dog? **She looks back to her comrades with a grin, met with a few nervous laughs.** No doubt sent here to deal with us. To force us to work ourselves to the bone so he can get fat off our labor!
->We'd just like to talk.
{npc:companyManMiner}Oh, we can talk! Let's talk about how slavery has been outlawed for several generations! How we aren't allowed to leave these mines without approval! How we're forced to work day in and day out, even when we're ill! The rations they give us are near spoiled, the compensation is an insult, and the living quarters aren't fit for beasts! 
**She inches closer, fists clenched.** 
{npc:companyManMiner}We came here because we were promised a fair wage and a better life than the ones we left behind. If {npcName:companyManNpc} wants us to work, he damn well better meet our demands!
->I'm here to do a job, not to negotiate. Either get back to work, or we'll put you and everyone else to the sword.
    {npc:companyManMiner}We're willing to die for our cause, dog! Can you say the same?
    ->**Prepare for combat**
        <<ShowPartyOnRegionTileset SE.CompanyManBattleOutside>>
        <<stop>>
->Can we not end this peacefully?
    {npc:companyManMiner}{npcName:companyManNpc}'s control over our lives has to end. He must relinquish his right to these mines so that we, the workers control it.
    ->I can't imagine he'll agree to those terms.
        {npc:companyManMiner}Do you know how this conflict started? My husband passed out from the labor and one of the guards beat him to death for taking a break. We told {npcName:companyManNpc}'s former man in charge we wanted something to be done. Do you know what he did to our request? Butchered 3 of our own. I personally cut off his head with a dull rusty blade. He did not go quickly.
        ->I understand your plight but I was hired for a job. Get back to work or we're going to have a problem.
            {npc:companyManMiner}That's too bad. We're willing to die for our cause. Can you say the same?
            ->**Prepare for combat**
                <<ShowPartyOnRegionTileset SE.CompanyManBattleOutside>>
        ->Alright, I'm on your side. Let me help.
            {npc:companyManMiner}If that's true then there is something you can do. If {npcName:companyManNpc} still trusts you then I want you to go back and meet with him. I'll go with you. Just get me close to him.
            ->That seems dangerous.
                {npc:companyManMiner}My husband didn't deserve to die. I have to do this, not just for him but to ensure nobody else ends up like him. At a certain point the workers have to stand up and unite. We won't be bullied by these rich assholes who've never worked a day in their life.
                ->Ok then. We can head out when you're ready.
                    {npc:companyManMiner}My name is {npcName:companyManMiner} by the way. It's nice to meet you.
                    **A horn blares and a rider on a horse storms over the hill and into the encampment. He discusses something with {npcName:companyManMiner} for a bit before she looks to up at you.**
                    {npc:companyManMiner}It seems {npcName:companyManNpc} didn't trust you'd be able to finish the job so he sent his own goons behind you.
                    ->We'll help fend them off.
                        <<CompleteQuest Quest.CompanyMan "skipTurnInEvent,skipResults">>
                        <<AssignQuest Quest.CompanyManJoinRevolt>> 
                        <<ShowPartyOnRegionTileset SE.CompanyManJoinRevoltBattleDefense>>
        ->I don't want to take sides in this matter. I'm leaving.
            {npc:companyManMiner}Coward. No matter, we intend to resolve this ourselves.
            ->**Leave**
                <<FailQuest Quest.CompanyMan>>
                <<stop>>

title: SE.CompanyWorkJoinRevoltEnding
tags: ScriptedEvent
groupName: Company Work
position: 615,1502
---
<<set $EventTrigger to "ON_WORLD_MAP_LOAD">>
<<set $CheckForActiveQuest to "[TurnIn]Quest.CompanyManJoinRevolt">>

{npc:companyManMiner}Thanks for you help. I couldn't have gotten close to him if it wasn't for you.

<<endif>>

    <<stop>>
->[Merciful,Honorable,Cautious]Let's approach them and see if we can come to a peaceful resolution. **Reason with them**
    **You approach the bandits with hands raised, signaling your intent for negotiation. Your companions stand behind you, ready to draw weapons at a moment's notice. The thieve's ringleader edges toward you, weapon leveled in your direction.**
    <<CreateNpc "id:banditNpc,name:Bandit,img:OldPriest">>
    <<CreateNpc "id:travelerNpc,name:Traveler,img:OldPriest">>
    {npc:banditNpc}This don't concern you none. **They nod their head to the side.** Get lost!
    ->[Rash,Brave,Harsh]I was hoping we could settle this peacefully, but I've changed my mind. **Attack the Bandits**
        <<AddCitizenToGuildOpinion closest 15>>
        **The bandit grins, waving a hand to their associates.**
        {npc:banditNpc}Hah! We'll be more than happy to pick from your corpses as well.
        ->**Fight**
            <<ShowPartyOnRegionTileset SE.WorldEventTravelersUnderAttackBattleStart>>
            <<stop>>
    ->[Merciful,Cautious,Cowardly,Content,CheckGold:200]There's no need for violence here. Take this coin and be on your way. **Offer 200[coin]**
        <<AddCitizenToGuildOpinion closest 15>>        
        **The bandit thumbs at their chin, considering the offer.** 
        <<if getRandomChance(70) is "true">>
        {  
            {npc:banditNpc}Alright, you've got yourselves a deal. Don't go following us now, you hear?   
            <<ModifyGold -200>>
            **As the bandits flee the scene, one of the travelers approaches you, letting out a great sigh of relief.**
            {npc:travelerNpc}Thank you, my friends. I'm afraid we would have lost our lives had you not showed up. **He digs around in his pocket, producing a few coins.** Here. It's not much, but I'm afraid it's all we can spare.
            <<ModifyGold 50>>
            ->We're just glad we could help. **Continue**
                <<stop>>
        }
        <<else>> 
        {
            {npc:banditNpc}You've deep pockets, uh? I think we'll take the rest of it too, then. **The bandit grins, waving a hand to their associates who spring into action.** 
            ->**Fight**
                <<ShowPartyOnRegionTileset SE.WorldEventTravelersUnderAttackBattleStart>>
                <<stop>>   
        }
        <<endif>>
    ->[Cowardly,Treacherous]We shouldn't have gotten involved. We'll be going, then. **Continue**
        <<AddCitizenToGuildOpinion closest -15>>
        <<stop>>

    <<AddCitizenToGuildOpinion closest -15>>
    <<stop>>

}
<<elseif $temp is 5>> 
{
    <<CreateItem "itm_retrieveGood" "Children's Toys And Trinkets" "Various children's toys and trinkets." "250">>
}
<<endif>>

<<if hasHighCityRep() is "true">> 
{
    {npc:retrieveGoodsNpc}Well, if it isn't the [CompanyName]. You're always welcome within [questTown], as far as I'm concerned. I assume you saw my notice?

    {npc:retrieveGoodsNpc}Splendid. I deal in all sorts of wares and supplies, but right now I'm in need of some [itemNameLower:itm_retrieveGood] as soon as possible. My stock is running low and the demand here is high! I've already lined up a sale in [destinationCity], so the sooner you can bring it to me, the better. I'll pay you double their value when you return.
}
<<else>>
{
    {npc:retrieveGoodsNpc}What'll it be?

I've already lined up a sale in [destinationCity], so the sooner you can bring it to me, the better. I'll pay you fifty-percent above their value when you return.

{

    {advisor}I can take a guess at what happened. 
    **[FNameP0] snorts, bending down to inspect the corpses.**
    {player:0}None seem to match the barkeep's description of her husband. There's some fresh tracks here, so I'd wager this was a recent incident.
    ->Let's follow them and see where they go.
        [[node.GeneralFindPersonContractHusbandWasKiller]]
}
<<elseif $MissingPersonVariation is 1>>
{
    **You arrive at the location, trying not to gag as an awful smell perverts the air. A few dead and charred bodies lie just off the road ahead of you, and beside them, the remains of a trade cart, now little more than ashes.
    {advisor}A terrible way to die...
    **[FNameP0] nods, bending down to inspect the corpses.**
    {player:0}None seem to match the barkeep's description of her husband, though it's hard to tell with the burns. There's some fresh tracks here though, so I'd wager this was a recent incident.
    ->Let's follow them and see where they go.
        [[node.GeneralFindPersonContractHusbandWasKiller]]
}
<<elseif $MissingPersonVariation is 2>>
{
    <<set $MissingPersonEnding to 2>>
    **You come to a group of buildings not far from the road, a small settlement housing no more than a few families. A man emerges to greet you from one of the humble dwellings, a merchant's wagon parked alongside it.**
    {npc:merchantNpc}I'm afraid I have nothing to sell right now, if that's why you're here.
    ->We're looking for a man. He and his wife run a tavern back in [questTown]. I believe you had business with him?
    {npc:merchantNpc}Ah, of course. **He pauses, raising his hands.** I'll be honest with you: he was with another woman. Didn't seem like he planned on heading back to [questTown], either. They bought a few things and moved on, but that was weeks ago now.
    ->She won't be glad to hear that. But at least she'll know the truth. 
    {npc:merchantNpc}Aye. She's a good woman. Certainly deserves a better husband. He's always been trouble, and from what I've seen, she is probably better off without him. 
    ->I'll be off then.
        <<SetPrimaryQuestObjectiveComplete "Return to [questTown] and inform the barkeep of her husband's infidelity">>
        <<stop>>
}
<<elseif $MissingPersonVariation is 3>>
{
    **You come to a group of buildings not far from the road, a small settlement housing no more than a few families. Beside one of the humble dwellings lies a trade cart with two men standing next to it, engaged in friendly conversation.** 
    {advisor}That looks like our man, no? 
    **They stop talking and turn toward you with a friendly nod as you approach.**
    {npc:merchantNpc}Yes? Can we help you?
    ->We were hired to look for someone. **Nod in the husband's direction.** You, I presume. 
    **The husband smiles, looking a little embarassed.**
    {npc:findPersonHusbandNpc}She hired you, did she? I figured she might be getting anxious, but never thought she'd actually send someone to look for me. **He chuckles, gesturing to his leg.** I went and got myself injured on the trip over here. Can't ride my horse as of yet, but I'll be fit for travel in a few days. If you could pass that message along to her, I would appreciate it. It would at least set her mind at ease.
    ->We'll let her know. **Leave**
        <<set $MissingPersonEnding to 3>>
        <<SetPrimaryQuestObjectiveComplete "Return to [questTown] and inform the barkeep of her husband's injury">>
    ->We've room in one of our carriages if you'd like to hitch a ride back to town. Better than riding a horse, at least. 
        <<set $MissingPersonEnding to 4>>
        {npc:findPersonHusbandNpc}Really? I don't want to trouble you.
        ->It's no trouble at all.
            {npc:findPersonHusbandNpc}Well alright, then. I'll be ready in a moment.
            <<AddCitizenToGuildOpinion closest 5>>
            ->**Continue**
                <<SetPrimaryQuestObjectiveComplete "Escort the husband back to [questTown]">>
                <<stop>>
}
<<endif>>

    **His eyes light up.**
    {npc:serumMerchant}That is fortuitous! Might I accompany you? I'm sure a company such as yours is allowed to come and go freely.         ->**Continue**
            <<stop>>
    ->[Treacherous,Greedy]I'd prefer all the profits instead. **Steal for yourselves**
        {npc:serumMerchant}What!? No, please!
        **As [FNameP0] edges toward the carriage, the man tries to spur his horse forward in a panic. As he fumbles with the reins, his hands are seized by [FNameP1], who drags him down to the dirt road with a thud.**
        <<GiveItem "tioSerum">>
        ->**Continue**
            <<stop>>
    ->[Cowardly,Content]We're not interested. **Decline contract**
        {npc:serumMerchant}That's a shame. Well, I suppose I will figure something out.
        ->**Continue**

**Amongst the sea of defenders, you pick out the Vanguard standard flying high and make your way towards it, shouldering past both soldiers and civilians who have been called upon to save the city, regardless of their age or ability. As you approach, you spot the Officer emerging from a war tent, fully adorned in a suit of armor and issuing orders to a pair of soldiers at his side. With a salute, the three of them part ways. The Officer strides toward you, the faintest smile upon his stressed face.** 
<<if $ScourgeCrisisHelped is "true">>
{
    {npc:vanguardOfficerNpc}They'll be here soon enough. The [CompanyName] have done plenty to help over the last few weeks. I'm glad you've decided to see it through. The city will be in your debt should it remain standing.

<<else>>

}
<<endif>>

    {
    	**The Officer glances around to survey the situation.**
    	{npc:vanguardOfficerNpc}Our numbers are high, and our defenses strong. I believe it will be enough. 
    }
    <<elseif $scourgeCityStrength is "high">> 
    {
    	**The Officer nods assuringly.**
    	{npc:vanguardOfficerNpc}We've faced greater numbers in the past. Our forces look up to the task at hand. 
    }
    <<elseif $scourgeCityStrength is "moderate">> 
    {
    	**He takes in a breath, pondering the question.**
    	{npc:vanguardOfficerNpc}We were able to stem the tide of Voidspawn coming this way, at least. We'll soon find out if our efforts were enough, won't we?
    }
    <<elseif $scourgeCityStrength is "low">> 
    {
    	**The Officer shrugs, doing little to hide his doubt.**
    	{npc:vanguardOfficerNpc}Truthfully, I'm not convinced. But we're bound by oath and have little choice in the matter. I suppose now that the [CompanyName] are here, our chances have improved a little, no? 
    }
    <<elseif $scourgeCityStrength is "veryLow">> 
    {
    	**He purses his lips before letting go of a sigh.**
    	{npc:vanguardOfficerNpc}The city was already in rough shape even before the Scourge began. Honestly? It will take a miracle. 
    }
    <<endif>>
    **A horn blares in the distance, and the Officer's eyes narrow.** 
    {npc:vanguardOfficerNpc}Sounds like they're here. We'd best get into position, then. Good luck to you all.
    ->And to you. 
    **You join the battle lines amongst hundreds of others, some wielding little more than a pitchfork but not lacking determination. In the distance, dark figures begin to emerge along the horizon, their numbers seemingly multiplying with each passing moment as they draw closer. You look on as an eerie silence falls over the battlefield.**
    {advisor}Calm before the storm...
    {player:0}Aye. Except most storms aren't actively trying to kill you.
    <<if $scourgeCityStrength is "veryHigh">>

        <<AddTempPartyMember VanguardSoldierAlly hordeDefenseAlly2>>
        <<AddTempPartyMember VanguardSoldierAlly hordeDefenseAlly3>>
        <<AddTempPartyMember VanguardSoldierAlly hordeDefenseAlly4>>

		<<AddTempPartyMember VanguardSoldierAlly hordeDefenseAlly0>>
        <<AddTempPartyMember VanguardSoldierAlly hordeDefenseAlly1>>
        <<AddTempPartyMember VanguardSoldierAlly hordeDefenseAlly2>>
        <<AddTempPartyMember VanguardSoldierAlly hordeDefenseAlly3>>

    {player:$CharacterWithJob}This shrine is dedicated to Phaetes, the God of Destiny. With an offering of blood, he may show us a glimpse of what dangers lie ahead.
    <<if getRandomChance(20) is "true">>
        <<if getCharacterWithTrait("OpenMinded") is "true">> 
            {hasTrait:OpenMinded}I'm not much of a believer in destiny, but I suppose I could be persuaded.
        <<endif>>
    <<endif>>
<<else>> 
    **You come across an old shrine, though you cannot discern which god it is dedicated to.**
<<endif>>

    <<MakeHealthOffering true>>

    <<MakeCoinOffering false>>
->[RequireItem:tio_Idol]This idol should do the trick. **Offer an idol**
    <<MakeIdolOffering false>>
->Maybe we'll come back to this. **Leave**
    <<stop>>
<<SetEventFinished>>

        <<endif>>

            <<stop>>

        <<stop>>

        <<MakeIdolOffering true>>
    ->Maybe we'll come back to this. **Leave**
        <<stop>>
    <<SetEventFinished>>
    **A villainous cackle floats through the air...**
    <<if getRandomChance(50) is "true">>
        <<ForceGiveShrineReward DymosPwr>>
        {player:0}Gods, I feel terrible. I can hardly lift my weapon!
        {advisor}This damned thing is cursed!
    <<else>>
        <<ForceGiveShrineReward DymosNewEnemies>>
        {advisor}This damned thing is cursed!
        **[FNameP0] swivels around, raising their weapon to point out a new threat.**
        {player:0}Specters, [myTitle]! It seems the Gods were not fond of our sacrifice. 
        {advisor}I don't think they've seen us yet. We should tread carefully...
    <<endif>>
    ->Shit. **Continue**
        <<stop>>

title: SE.KnowledgeGeneric0
tags: ScriptedEvent
groupName: Dynamic Exploration Events
position: -558,552
---
<<set $Icon to "Reading">>
<<set $TriggerTags to "generic,positive">>
<<set $DaysUntilRepeat to 60>> 
//This grants (100*DungeonDifficulty) XP to party (as a base value, would ideally be increased with Scholar or rested XP)
**You find a misplaced journal from a local adventurer. Your party may benefit from a detailed account of their experiences.**
->[Time:5]This may be worth reading. **Read**
    **You read a few passages aloud to your companions, and indeed they seem to have learned a thing or two.**
    {advisor}Some good lessons in there, I reckon.
    <<if getRandomChance(50) is "true">>
        <<if getCharacterWithTrait("OpenMinded") is "true">> 
            {hasTrait:OpenMinded}It's certainly an interesting point of view. 
        <<elseif getCharacterWithTrait("Harsh") is "true">> 
            {hasTrait:Harsh}On what not to do, perhaps. I mean, this person must have died in here, no? We don't exactly want to follow in their footsteps.
        <<elseif getXCharactersWithTraits("Honorable,Greedy") is "true">> 
            {player:[$Person0]}They seemed to have lived a life of honor. You can't ask for more than that.
            {player:[$Person1]}Yes, yes. An honorable life, but one of poverty. I'll sacrifice my honor for a sack of coins any day. 
        <<elseif getXCharactersWithTraits("Cautious,Rash") is "true">> 
            {player:[$Person0]}Such as erring on the side of caution.
            {player:[$Person1]}Bah! Caution is overrated.
        <<endif>>
    <<endif>>
    <<GivePartyXP 100 true>>
    ->Let's head out. **Continue**
        <<SetEventFinished>>
        <<stop>>
->Leave it be. We must keep moving. **Continue**
    <<stop>>

title: SE.RunesLevelUp
tags: ScriptedEvent
groupName: Dynamic Exploration Events
position: -2111,567
---
<<set $Icon to "Runes">>
<<set $TriggerTags to "generic,positive,rune">>
<<set $Tileset to "cave,crypt">>
<<set $EventClassification to "Positive">>
<<set $DaysUntilRepeat to 60>> 
<<if checkForJob("Scholar") == "true">>
    **An ancient inscription marks the wall ahead of you. [$CharacterWithJobName]'s eyes widen as they rush forward to decipher its meaning.**
    {player:$CharacterWithJob}Fascinating! These runes still hold some magic in them, but perhaps only enough for one of us. 
    <<if getRandomChance(20) is "true">>
        <<if getCharacterWithTrait("Greedy") is "true">> 
            {hasTrait:Greedy}May I? 
        <<elseif getCharacterWithTrait("Cautious") is "true">>
            {hasTrait:Cautious}Mysterious and magical runes - what could go wrong?
            {player:$CharacterWithJob}I assure you, it's perfectly safe.
        <<endif>>
    <<endif>>
    ->Let's see what magic it contains.
        **Choose a character to interact with the runes and level up.**
        <<CreateRuneToucherList>>
        **[$RuneToucherName] steps up and places their hand on the runes, whose soft glow momentarily intensifies with a hum before fading entirely.**
        **[$RuneToucherName] has gained a level.**
        ->**Continue**
            <<GiveLevel>>
            <<SetEventFinished>>
            <<stop>>
    ->Maybe we'll come back to this later. **Continue**
        <<stop>>
<<else>>
    **An ancient inscription marks the wall ahead, though its meaning eludes everyone in your party.**
    {advisor}I can't make heads or tails of this, [myTitle]. **He glances around.** Anyone feeling brave?
    ->Let's see what magic it contains.
        **Choose a character to interact with the runes.**
        <<CreateRuneToucherList>>
        **[$RuneToucherName] steps up and places their hand on the runes, whose soft glow momentarily intensifies with a hum before fading entirely.**
        **[$RuneToucherName] has gained a level.**
        ->**Continue**
            <<GiveLevel>>
            <<SetEventFinished>>
            <<stop>>
    ->Maybe we'll come back to this later. **Continue**
        <<stop>>
<<endif>>

title: SE.ExplorationEventThief
tags: ScriptedEvent
groupName: Unknown Dungeon Events
position: -838,-165
---
//update this and maybe include variant with the tracker alerting you to someone's presence (chance for it to be nothing or something)
<<set $DaysUntilRepeat to 140>>
<<set $Icon to "Unknown">>
<<set $TriggerTags to "generic,neutral">>
<<set $Tileset to "cave,crypt,fort">>
**You stop for a moment, overcome by a strong feeling that someone or something is watching you.**
<<SetEventFinished>>
->[Time:8,Cautious]I've a feeling we're not alone here. Check the area. 
    <<if getRandomChance(40) is "true">>
        **Your party fans out with eyes peeled and weapons readied, but a thorough search of the area turns up nothing and clears your mind of any worries you might have had.**
        <<if getXCharactersWithTraits("Any,Cautious") is "true">>
        {
            {player:[$Person0]}Mind playing tricks on you, uh boss? 
            {player:[$Person1]}Still, it doesn't hurt to be careful.
        }
        <<endif>>
        ->Let's press on. **Continue**
            <<stop>>
    <<else>> 
        <<if checkForJob("Tracker") == "true">>
            **You fan out to search your surroundings. On the edge of your vision, you spot a shadowy figure emerging from the shadows, charging in your direction. He stops dead in his tracks as your eyes meet. A thief, perhaps, hoping to catch you off guard.**
            ->What do you want?
                **The man doesn't respond and instead turns tail and runs, his dark cape whipping up behind him.**
                {player:0}Yeah, I would run, too!
                <<AdjustPartySpirit 10>> 
                ->No point chasing him, but we should keep our eyes peeled. **Continue**
                    <<stop>>
            ->[Harsh]A thief - kill him!
                <<PlaySound StabbedToDeath>>
                **Without hesitation, one of your comrades charges at the man and buries a dagger into his chest before he can even react. The man's eyes bulge and he collapses, gasping as blood pours from his wound -  a truly gruesome end.**
                <<if getCharacterWithOppositeOfTrait("Harsh") == "true">> 
                {
                    {hasTrait:Harsh}Was that really necessary, boss? He hardly seemed a threat.
                }
                <<endif>>
                <<if getCharacterWithTrait("Greedy") == "true">> 
                {
                    {hasTrait:Greedy}Might as well search the body. He may have something of value.
                }
                <<endif>>
                **You rifle through the man's meager possessions, taking only what is worthwhile.**
                <<ModifyGold 100>>
                ->**Continue**
                    <<stop>> 
        <<else>> 
            **It seems as though your fears were unwarranted as your search comes up empty. Moments later, however, you are shoved to the ground, your palms scraping against the floor.**
            <<RemoveItem>> 
            **You twist around, looking in all directions, but the culprit has already escaped into the shadows. [FNameP0] holds out [pronounPoss0] hand over you, pulling you upright with a grunt.**
            {player:0}A slippery bastard, that one. We'd best stay alert.
            ->Damned thieves. **Continue**
                <<stop>> 
        <<endif>> 
    <<endif>>
->[Rash]It's probably nothing. Let's keep going.
    <<if getRandomChance(40) is "true">>
        **Despite your instincts, you decide to press on.**
        ->**Continue**
            <<stop>>
    <<else>>
        **Despite your instincts, you decide to press on. Moments later, however, you are shoved to the ground, your palms scraping against the floor. You twist around, looking in all directions, but the culprit has already escaped into the shadows.**
        <<RemoveItem>> 
        <<RemoveItem>>
        <<if getCharacterWithOppositeOfTrait("Rash") == "true">> 
        {
            **[$CharacterWithTraitName] holds out [pronounPoss[$CharacterWithTrait]] hand over you, pulling you upright with a grunt.** 
            {player:$CharacterWithTrait}You alright, boss? We should be more careful next time. A little caution never hurt anyone.
        }
        <<else>>
        {
            **[FNameP0] holds out [pronounPoss0] hand over you, pulling you upright with a grunt.**
            {player:0}A slippery bastard, that one. We'd best stay alert.
        }
        <<endif>> 
        ->Damned thieves. **Continue**
            <<stop>> 
    <<endif>>

title: SE.ExplorationEventInjuredNPC
tags: 
groupName: Unknown Dungeon Events
position: 2380,-734
---
//disabled for now, want to update a bit of it. need to update the loot as now giveitem uses the loot table i think?
<<set $Icon to "Unknown">>
<<set $DaysUntilRepeat to 240>>
<<set $TriggerTags to "generic,Neutral">>
<<set $Tileset to "cave,crypt">>
<<CreateNpc "id:tempNpc,name:Injured Man,img:maleCivilian">>
**You round a corner to find a young man slumped against the wall, barely conscious with blood pooling around him from a wound in his gut. He looks up at you through pained eyes.**
{npc:tempNpc}Thank the gods, I was beginning to think no one would find me. **He glances down, hand clutching his wound.** I was attacked by some beast...only just managed to get away, though not quickly enough. 
<<if getCharacterWithTrait("Merciful,Honorable") is "true">>
{
    **[$CharacterWithTraitName] steps beside you, whispering in your ear.** 
    {player:$CharacterWithTrait}That wound looks bad. I say we help him.
}
<<elseif getCharacterWithTrait("Harsh") is "true">>
{
    **[$CharacterWithTraitName] steps beside you, whispering in your ear.** 
    {player:$CharacterWithTrait}He's not long for this world, boss. No sense in wasting time on him, if you ask me.
}
<<elseif getCharacterWithTrait("Treacherous") is "true">>
{
    **[$CharacterWithTraitName] steps beside you, whispering in your ear.** 
    {player:$CharacterWithTrait}Helping him is futile; that wound looks fatal. I'd sooner kill him and take his possessions. We could at least make use of them.
}
<<else>> 
{
    **[FNameAdvisor] steps beside you, whispering in your ear.** 
    {advisor}That wound looks bad, [myTitle]. He'll not last long without help.
}
<<endif>>
->[Time:2,RequireItem:tio_bandage,Merciful,Honorable]We'll see to your wound.
    **Relief washes over the man's face, and he looks up as if to thank the gods.**
    <<RemoveItem tio_bandage>>
    {npc:tempNpc}Bless you, friends. I can hardly thank you enough, but I hope these items I found will suffice.
    <<GiveItem>>
    <<AddCitizenToGuildOpinion "current" "5">>
    {npc:tempNpc}I'll be on my way, then. I'll make sure the folks in town hear of this. 
    ->**Continue**
        <<stop>>
->[Time:1,RequireItem:tio_smallHealthPotion,Merciful,Honorable]This potion should help for a while, at least long enough to find yourself a healer.
    **Relief washes over the man's face, and he looks up as if to thank the gods.**
    <<RemoveItem tio_smallHealthPotion>>
    {npc:tempNpc}Bless you, friends. I can hardly thank you enough, but I hope these items I found will suffice.
    <<GiveItem>>
    <<AddCitizenToGuildOpinion "current" "5">> 
    {npc:tempNpc}I'll be on my way, then. I'll make sure the folks in town hear of this. 
    ->**Continue**
        <<stop>>
//TODO: change this option to be a escort to city quest pick-up
->[Time:6,Honorable,Merciful]I'll escort him to safety. The rest of you should wait here.
    <<if getCharacterWithOppositeOfTrait("Merciful,Honorable") == "true">> 
    {
        {hasTrait:Harsh,Treacherous}We don't have time for this, boss. We should just leave him.
    }
    <<endif>> 
    **You help the man up, draping his arm around your shoulder as you head toward an exit. Having reached safety, he gives you a small reward as thanks, and you head back in to rejoin your party.**
    <<GiveItem>>
    <<AddCitizenToGuildOpinion "current" "5">> 
    {advisor}Well? Did he make it?
    ->He did. Let's keep moving.
        <<stop>> 
->[Treacherous,Harsh]It's a shame we didn't arrive in time to save you. **Kill and loot him**
    {npc:tempNpc}Wait, what are you--
    <<PlaySound StabbedToDeath>>
    **His words become gurgles as you wedge a small blade through his neck, blood pouring out as all life drains from his eyes.**
    <<if getCharacterWithOppositeOfTrait("Harsh,Treacherous") == "true">> 
    {
        {hasTrait:Merciful,Honorable}What have you done? We could have saved him!
    }
    <<endif>> 
    <<GiveItem>>
    <<GiveItem>>
    ->Let's go.
        <<stop>> 
->[Harsh]I'm sorry but we can't afford to waste resources on a lost cause. You'd need a miracle to survive that wound. **Leave him**
    {npc:tempNpc}No, wait, please! You can't just leave me here!
    <<if getCharacterWithOppositeOfTrait("Harsh") == "true">> 
    {
        {hasTrait:Merciful}This doesn't feel right, boss.
    }
    <<endif>> 
    **You signal your troop to continue onward, leaving the injured man behind in fate's hand, his strained voice pleading after you all the while.**
    ->Continue
        <<stop>>

<<set $TriggerTags to "Mining,positive">>
<<set $Tileset to "cave,crypt">>
<<set $Requirements to "Trap">>
<<InitTrap>>
**As you round the corner, the light of your torch reveals an iron vein running along the wall ahead of you.**
<<if checkForJob("Miner") == "true">>
    {player:$CharacterWithJob}Good thing I came with, eh? You'd have had your hands full with this. **[$CharacterWithJobName] moves closer to inspect the vein.** Shall we get started then?
    ->[Time:5]We'll follow your lead, [$CharacterWithJobName]. **Mine the iron (15% chance of cave-in)**
        <<PlaySound ShovelDirt>>
        **[$CharacterWithJobName] sets to work with assistance from the rest of your party.**
        <<if getRandomChance(15) is "true">>
            <<ShakeScreen 1.5 2>>
            <<PlaySound LargeRocksFallingQuick>>
            **A cave-in occurs, and your party scrambles to take cover...**
            <<if getRandomChance(50) is "true">> 
                **The rubble will take some time to clear, but fortunately nobody suffers anything beyond a few bumps and scrapes.**
                {player:$CharacterWithJob}It should be safe to continue, boss.
                ->[Time:5]Let's clean this up. **Continue**
                    [[node.IronYield]] 
            <<elseif getRandomChance(25) is "true">>
                <<ShakeScreen 1.5 1>>
                <<TriggerTrap>>
                ->Damn it. Let's try to be more careful. **Continue**
                    [[node.IronYield]] 
            <<else>>
                **Fortunately, nobody suffers anything beyond a few bumps and scrapes, but the iron is now beyond your reach, buried beneath an unmovable pile of earth.**
                {player:$CharacterWithJob}There's no chance of salvaging anything, I'm afraid. 
                ->It was worth a shot. **Continue**
                    <<SetEventFinished>>
                    <<stop>>
            <<endif>>
        <<endif>>
        [[node.IronYield]] 
    ->[Time:1,Rash]A well placed blast of magic should do the trick. **Extract iron with magic (30% chance of cave-in)**
        **Under [$CharacterWithJobName]'s direction, your party blasts the wall with magic, hoping to collect some material from the rubble.**
        <<PlaySound RockExplosion>>
        <<ShakeScreen 1.5 3>>
        <<if getRandomChance(30) is "true">>
            <<ShakeScreen 1.5 2>>
            <<PlaySound LargeRocksFallingQuick>>
            **A cave-in occurs, and your party scrambles to take cover...**
            <<if getRandomChance(30) is "true">> 
                **The rubble will take some time to clear, but fortunately nobody suffers anything beyond a few bumps and scrapes.**
                {player:$CharacterWithJob}It should be safe to continue, boss.
                ->[Time:5]Let's clean this up. **Continue**
                    [[node.IronYield]] 
            <<elseif getRandomChance(35) is "true">>
                <<ShakeScreen 1.5 1>>
                <<TriggerTrap>>
                ->Damn it. Let's try to be more careful. **Continue**
                    [[node.IronYield]] 
            <<else>>
                **Fortunately, nobody suffers anything beyond a few bumps and scrapes, but the iron is now beyond your reach, buried beneath an unmovable pile of earth.**
                {player:$CharacterWithJob}There's no chance of salvaging anything, I'm afraid. 
                ->It was worth a shot. **Continue**
                    <<SetEventFinished>>
                    <<stop>>
            <<endif>>
        <<endif>>
        [[node.IronYield]]
    ->Forget it. **Leave**
        <<stop>>
<<else>>
    {advisor}Shall we give it a shot? None of us are experts here so it may take some time...
    ->[Time:10,RemoveRequiredItem:tio_tools]Well, it would be a shame to leave it here. **Mine with tools (30% chance of cave-in)**
        <<PlaySound ShovelDirt>>
        **Your troops each take up a tool, hoping to mine as much as you can.**
        <<if getRandomChance(30) is "true">>
            <<ShakeScreen 1.5 2>>
            <<PlaySound LargeRocksFallingQuick>>
            **A cave-in occurs, and your party scrambles to take cover...**
            <<if getRandomChance(20) is "true">> 
                **The rubble will take some time to clear, but fortunately nobody suffers anything beyond a few bumps and scrapes.**
                {advisor}That could have been worse.
                ->[Time:10]Let's clean this up. **Continue**
                    [[node.IronYieldNoMiner]] 
            <<elseif getRandomChance(30) is "true">>
                <<ShakeScreen 1.5 1>>
                <<TriggerTrap>>
                ->Damn it. Let's try to be more careful. **Continue**
                    [[node.IronYieldNoMiner]] 
            <<else>>
                **Fortunately, nobody suffers anything beyond a few bumps and scrapes, but the iron is now beyond your reach, buried beneath an unmovable pile of earth.**
                {advisor}There's no chance of salvaging anything, I'm afraid. 
                ->It was worth a shot. **Continue**
                    <<SetEventFinished>>
                    <<stop>>
            <<endif>>
        <<endif>>
        [[node.IronYieldNoMiner]] 
    ->[Time:1,Rash]A well placed blast of magic should do the trick. **Extract iron with magic (55% chance of cave-in)**
        **Your party blasts the wall with magic, hoping to collect some material from the rubble.**
        <<PlaySound RockExplosion>>
        <<ShakeScreen 1.5 3>>
        <<if getRandomChance(55) is "true">>
            <<ShakeScreen 1.5 2>>
            <<PlaySound LargeRocksFallingQuick>>
            **A cave-in occurs, and your party scrambles to take cover...**
            <<if getRandomChance(10) is "true">> 
                **The rubble will take some time to clear, but fortunately nobody suffers anything beyond a few bumps and scrapes.**

                ->[Time:10]Let's clean this up. **Continue**

            <<stop>>

        <<PlaySound SliceBodyImpact>>
        <<if getCharacterWithTrait("Harsh") is "true">>
            {hasTrait:Harsh}Looks like you need to study more, [$CharacterWithJobName].
        <<endif>>
        {advisor}Everyone alright at least?
        {player:$CharacterWithJob}Damn it! Sorry, everyone. 
        ->We'll live. **Continue**
            <<stop>> 
    <<endif>>

    <<MoveToPrevTile>>

    {npc:campaignCommanderOwaynNpc}There might be a few stragglers roaming out there in the frozen tundra, but Wealden should be inhabitable once again, as soon as we clean up the dead here, that is. <<CreateNpc "id:demonsDenNPC,name:[questHouse] Commander,img:npc_male_friendly">>
