<<ModifyGlobalVar $DemonsDenOneAlly "false">>
<<ModifyGlobalVar $DemonsDenClosedBreach "false">>
**You can hear his pacing--more like stomping--even before you cross the barracks to his office door. Harried looking and dripping with sweat, the guard commander turns to you with wild eyes, as if expecting an attack.**
{npc:demonsDenNPC}Someone answered, finally! Listen, we've found the culprit for this whole voidspawn threat. Problem is, I've lost too many good men and women fighting them. I can't give up our reserves or [questTown] could be overrun.
{npc:demonsDenNPC}We backtracked the source of the demons' raids to an abandoned mine in the hills. I sent a significant force in there after them. They eliminated the majority of the demons but with great losses. I need someone bold to go underground and close the void breach from whence these things are spawning.
->Tell us where to go. **Accept Contract**
    {npc:demonsDenNPC}That's what I want to hear! **He blearily scrutinizes your map.** This is where you'll find it. One other thing: two of my best people were cut off from the group and could still be alive. I'd appreciate you looking for them.
    ->**Continue**
        <<AssignQuest Quest.DemonsDen>>
        <<stop>>
->Sounds dangerous. We're not interested right now. **Decline Contract**
    {npc:demonsDenNPC}By the time you work up an interest, we'll all be dead and [questTown] a smoldering ruin.
    ->**Continue**
        <<DeclineQuest Quest.DemonsDen>>
        <<stop>>

    ->They suffered quite an ordeal. They're resting up in the infirmary as we speak.
    {npc:demonsDenNPC}Unbelievable! I didn't think there were heroes like you left in this land. **The commander covers his eyes for a moment; it's all he can do to keep himself from weeping.** Here, you've earned every copper of this and more. **After you've taken your reward and said your goodbyes, the commander gives you a crisp salute.**
    ->**Continue**
        <<EndRegionalEvent VoidspawnActivity>>
        <<stop>>

    ->Thank you, Commander. **Continue**
        <<EndRegionalEvent VoidspawnActivity>>
        <<stop>>
<<else>>
    ->I'm afraid we could not save them.
    **The guard commander reaches out and grabs the back of a chair for support, but still sways, and for a moment you think he'll fall. He can't seem to raise his head.**
    {npc:demonsDenNPC}That is hard to take... So many dead. **He quickly shakes his head, trying to compose himself.** Anyway, here's your pay. I've no doubt you earned it.
    ->Thank you, Commander. We're sorry for your losses. **Continue**
        <<EndRegionalEvent VoidspawnActivity>>

title: SE.AltarOfStoneIntro
tags: ScriptedEvent
groupName: ContentUpdateQuests
position: -36,1269
---
<<CreateNpc "id:altarOfStoneNPC,name:Orlos,img:npc_male_friendly">>
<<ModifyGlobalVar $AltarOfStoneRetrieved "false">>
<<ModifyGlobalVar $AltarOfStoneWrongAltar "false">>
{npc:altarOfStoneNPC}Greetings, mercenaries. I am Orlos. Now let me see...
{npc:altarOfStoneNPC}You must be [FNameAdvisor], [FNameP0]...
{npc:altarOfStoneNPC}I could go on, but I have a most important task directly related to the safety of [questTown] and her citizens.
->How did you come to know our names?
{npc:altarOfStoneNPC}Well now, I can't be revealing my secrets.
<<if checkForJob("Scholar") == "true">>
    {player:$CharacterWithJob}Orlos Graybrow--there are rumors you were expelled from the Order of the Black Quill, the foremost guild of scholars in the land. Is it true?
    {hasTrait:Harsh}How does one get expelled from a guild of scholars? Did he steep the tea too long? Tip over one too many inkpots? Har!
    {npc:altarOfStoneNPC}It is true. I was expelled because I believe in the natural balance that ensures continuity in our world, while the Order insists upon the supremacy of man and his stone walls and towers over everything. But I do not count the Voidspawn among nature's creatures. Rest assured, we are all on the same side.
<<endif>>
->You mentioned a task?
//you need to get the stone from one chamber and move it to one of three altars. one of them will settle the quakes, the other 2 will not. he says the earth elemental is finicky like that. he also warns that he tried to hire another group for the task, but he suspects they have their eye on stealing the stone instead, believing it to be valuable. however he assures you it's quite worthless to anyone but the elemental. the company ambushes you in the cave
{npc:altarOfStoneNPC}I need you to go to a nearby mountain. Within its caverns are three altars.
{npc:altarOfStoneNPC}The northernmost altar currently has a magic stone placed upon it. I need you to retrieve it and move it to another. The correct chamber is... **He pulls out a notebook of his and scans through the pages.** Well, you'll come to a fork, the largest series of tunnels is the side you must go down. Do not place it on the other altar! It is not the right time of year for that.  
->Big tunnel, not the small. Got it. And what will that do?
{npc:altarOfStoneNPC}The altars are dedicated to an earth elemental--one of Teral's creations, I believe. It is a finnicky being, but I believe doing this will appease it and stop the recent earthquakes in the area.
->Indeed?
{npc:altarOfStoneNPC}The creature has a name, even, but it's of no use, sounds like two stones grinding together.
//<<if checkForJob("Miner") == "true">>
//{player:$CharacterWithJob}The presence of an earth elemental sometimes means valuable ore can be found, or is that simply superstition?
//**Orlos furrows his brow and ignores the question.**
//<<endif>>
->Sounds easy enough.
{npc:altarOfStoneNPC}Were that it so. I had previously hired a group for the very same task. Unfortunately, they got it in their heads that the stone is valuable and worth stealing. I can assure you it is quite worthless to anyone but the elemental. So you may have to contend with them as well.
{advisor}What other dangers might we face?
{npc:altarOfStoneNPC}The heart of the mountain is home to many charions, and moving the stone will likely upset them. Fire is their element, take note. **He digs around in his robe, producing a scroll.** This may be of use to you.
<<GiveItem "tioEnchantmentFireResist">>
//{Pyromancer} Ha! They can take note of me.
//{Icebinder} What's so amusing? Out of anyone, I'd say these monsters have the least to fear from you.
->Will we also have to fight this earth elemental?
{npc:altarOfStoneNPC}Oh no, you needn't fear it. It's quite harmless, except when it's shaking the city walls with earthquakes, hoho! It will probably observe you from somewhere nearby but it is completely invisible to us mere mortals.
->Point us to this mountain and we will do as you ask. **Accept Contract**
    {npc:altarOfStoneNPC}I knew I could place my trust in you. I'm never wrong about such things, you know.
    ->**Continue**
        <<AssignQuest Quest.AltarOfStone>>
        <<stop>>
->We're not prepared for this just yet. **Decline Contract**
    {npc:altarOfStoneNPC}Hmm. Well, don't wait too long. 
    ->**Continue**
        <<DeclineQuest Quest.AltarOfStone>>
        <<stop>>

===
title: SE.HouseOnHillIntro
tags: ScriptedEvent
groupName: ContentUpdateQuests
position: -777,1554
---
<<set $EventTrigger to "TRAVELING_ON_WORLD_MAP">>
//<<set $RequiredEvents to "FamineRelated">>
<<set $DaysUntilRepeat to -1>>
<<set $Priority to 5>>
<<set $RequiredMinDifficulty to "3">>
<<CreateNpc "id:houseOnHillNpc,name:Matilde,img:npc_female_friendly">>
<<ModifyGlobalVar $HouseOnHillPile1Burned "false">>
<<ModifyGlobalVar $HouseOnHillPile2Burned "false">>
<<ModifyGlobalVar $HouseOnHillNoPayment "false">>
<<ModifyGlobalVar $HouseOnHillVanguardRecruited "false">>
<<ModifyGlobalVar $HouseOnHillBossKilled "false">>
<<ModifyGlobalVar $HouseOnHillNotesTaken "false">>
<<ModifyGlobalVar $HouseOnHillVanguardTookNotes "false">>
<<ModifyGlobalVar $HouseOnHillMothersNecklaceFound "false">>
<<ModifyGlobalVar $HouseOnHillFoundCaptives "false">>
**A young woman stops you along the road, her pretty face dusty and careworn.**
{npc:houseOnHillNpc}Thank you for stopping. My name is Matilde. Perhaps you could help me?
->What is it you need?
{npc:houseOnHillNpc}I've been looking for my mother, Irini. She was coming to visit me and she's now a few days late.
->And this is the road she takes?
{npc:houseOnHillNpc}Yes, it's the only road, and... I believe I know where she is. Travelers in these parts often stay in an abandoned house near here. It's the only decent shelter for many miles in either direction. I was heading there myself, but if something is wrong I'm not sure I'll be able to handle it. Will you help a woman in need?
->[Honorable,Merciful]Of course, it's no trouble at all. Point the way. **Accept**
    <<AssignQuest Quest.HouseOnHill>>
    <<ModifyQuestRewardGold "Quest.HouseOnHill" 0.00>>
    {npc:houseOnHillNpc}Thank you ever so! The house is over yonder, not far from the road. I'll wait a safe distance away.
    ->We'll be back. **Continue**
        <<stop>>
->[Greedy,Treacherous,Harsh]You're willing to pay for this task? 
    {npc:houseOnHillNpc}I uhm... have some grain and salt you could take for trade. We earn little gold out in the countryside.
    ->That will do just fine. **Accept**
        <<AssignQuest Quest.HouseOnHill>>
        <<ModifyQuestRewardGold "Quest.HouseOnHill" 0.00>>
        {npc:houseOnHillNpc}Thank you ever so! The house is over yonder, not far from the road. I'll wait a safe distance away.
        ->We'll be back. **Continue**
            <<stop>>
    ->[Honorable,Merciful]In that case, payment isn't necessary. **Accept**
        <<AssignQuest Quest.HouseOnHill>>
        <<ModifyQuestRewardGold "Quest.HouseOnHill" 0.00>>
        <<ModifyGlobalVar $HouseOnHillNoPayment "true">>
        {npc:houseOnHillNpc}Thank you ever so! The house is over yonder, not far from the road. I'll wait a safe distance away.
        ->We'll be back. **Continue**
            <<stop>>
    ->I'm sorry but this isn't worth our time. **Decline**
        <<DeclineQuest Quest.HouseOnHill>>
        <<AddCitizenToGuildOpinion closest -10>>
        {npc:houseOnHillNpc}Oh. I suppose I'll have to investigate on my own, then. 
        ->**Continue**
            <<stop>>
->We don't have time for this right now. **Decline**
    <<DeclineQuest Quest.HouseOnHill>>
    <<AddCitizenToGuildOpinion closest -10>>
    {npc:houseOnHillNpc}Oh. I suppose I'll have to investigate on my own, then. 
    ->**Continue**
        <<stop>>

title: SE.HouseOnHillVanguard
tags: ScriptedEvent
groupName: ContentUpdateQuests
position: 3291,1552
---
<<set $Icon to "Unknown">>
<<CreateNpc "id:houseOnHillVanguard,name:Officer Brener,img:npc_male_friendly">>
<<if $HouseOnHillBossKilled is "false">>
    **With the blockage cleared, a man steps out of the darkness and into the light of your torches, his garments identifying him as a member of the Vanguard. His shield and weapon are raised, though his drooping posture and shaky limbs indicate he hasn't the strength to keep them that way for much longer.**
    {npc:houseOnHillVanguard}State your intentions!
    ->We're here looking for someone. Are you alright?  
        <<AddTempPartyMember VanguardSoldierAlly houseOnHillVanguard "Officer Brener">>
        <<ModifyGlobalVar $HouseOnHillVanguardRecruited "true">>
        {advisor}And what business do the Vanguard have here?
        {npc:houseOnHillVanguard}I've a few wounds. **The soldier relaxes, lowering his weapons and breathing a sigh.** The name's Brener. I was part of a group of Vanguard that were sent to investigate this place. We'd heard stories, but truly didn't think it would amount to anything. 
        **He shifts uncomfortably, clutching a bloody patch on the side of his garments.** 
        {npc:houseOnHillVanguard}There's a man down here responsible for all this madness. Just when we thought we had him defeated, he cast a spell that buried us in rubble. I was lucky. The others, not so much...
        {npc:houseOnHillVanguard}I didn't have the strength to clear the way myself. I'm fortunate you came along when you did. And now we can take on that monster all together, eh?
        ->[RemoveRequiredItem:tio_bandage]Let's patch you up first. **Bandage him**
            <<PlaySound UseBandage>>
            <<ModifyAllyStat houseOnHillVanguard HP 1.25>>
            {npc:houseOnHillVanguard}I appreciate it. It'll have to do until I can see a proper healer. Let's go, shall we?
            ->**Continue**
                <<SetEventFinished>>
                <<stop>>
        ->Indeed. We could use your help. **Continue**
            <<ModifyAllyStat houseOnHillVanguard HP 0.75>>
            <<SetEventFinished>>
            <<stop>>
    ->[Treacherous]It's a trick--kill him!
        <<PlaySound StabbedToDeath>>
        **Your comrades hesitate a moment before one finally buries a dagger into the soldier's neck. His eyes bulge with surprise as he drops his weapons, clutching uselessly at his bloody wound before collapsing to the ground.**
        <<AdjustGuildLoyaltyBasedOnTraitAction "Treacherous" 15>>
        <<AdjustGuildLoyaltyBasedOnTraitAction "Merciful" -15>>
        {hasTrait:Merciful,Honorable}Have you lost it, [myTitle]? A trick? The man plainly needed our help!
        {advisor}It wouldn't have hurt to hear him out.
        {hasTrait:Treacherous,Cowardly}Can't be too careful in a place like this, I suppose.
        ->Let's get moving. **Leave**
            <<SetEventFinished>>
            <<stop>>
        ->Take what's useful and let's get out of here. **Loot the corpse**
            <<GiveWeaponByType "polearm">> 
            <<GiveItem "tio_heaterShield">>
            ->**Continue**
                <<SetEventFinished>>
                <<stop>>
<<else>>
    **You spot a motionless man slumped against the wall, his blood-stained garments identifying him as a Vanguard soldier. [FNameP0] bends down to inspect the body.**
    {player:0}He's dead, [myTitle]. His body's still warm. Must have just passed.
    {advisor}I wonder what he was doing here?
    {player:0}Wrong place, wrong time, I assume. Just like the others.
    ->Let's get moving. **Leave**
        <<SetEventFinished>>
        <<stop>>
    ->Take what's useful and let's get out of here. **Loot the corpse**
        <<GiveWeaponByType "polearm">> 
        <<GiveItem "tio_heaterShield">>
        ->**Continue**
            <<SetEventFinished>>
            <<stop>>
<<endif>>

title: SE.HouseOnHillGhost
tags: ScriptedEvent
groupName: ContentUpdateQuests
position: 329,1551
---
<<set $Icon to "Unknown">>
<<CreateNpc "id:houseOnHillGhost,name:Erlich's Spirit,img:npc_male_friendly">>
{player:0}Look there, a specter!
**A translucent shape with a human silhouette hovers in the air several yards away.**
<<if checkForJob("Theologian") == "true">>
    {player:$CharacterWithJob}Considering the goings-on here, it's no wonder ghosts haunt this place.
<<endif>>
{hasTrait:Cautious}Ready yourselves, there may be others!
{hasTrait:Merciful}Wait... it may not mean us harm.
->It's gesturing to us. Stand fast.
**The apparition moves closer, its features resolving into those of a rugged-looking man.**
->Who are you?
{npc:houseOnHillGhost}I--I used to be called... Erlich. It's been...many years since I've said that aloud.
->How did you end up here?
{npc:houseOnHillGhost}I was traveling and stopped to rest for the night. A man snatched me and dragged me down here... to be experimented on. My spirit is now stuck here like many others', though not all are as friendly as I.
{advisor}There are more of you?
{npc:houseOnHillGhost}You're bound to meet some of them, for we are all trapped in these cursed caves--doomed to wander endlessly...unless...
->Can we free you?
    <<if checkForJob("Theologian") == "true">>
    {player:$CharacterWithJob}Their bodies are likely keeping them on this plane. If we can burn them, perhaps their spirits will finally be freed.
    <<else>>
        {advisor}Their bodies are likely keeping them on this plane. If we can burn them, perhaps their spirits will finally be freed.
    <<endif>>
    {npc:houseOnHillGhost}Yes! There are three piles throughout these caverns. Burning them should set us free and thin the number of vengeful spirits you will need to contend with down here. Most of all, I ask that you kill the man responsible for our deaths. Only then will we truly be at peace.
    **The apparition gestures to a long, ugly stain on the floor, leading to a heap of corpses stuffed into a recess along the wall. When you look back, it has vanished.**
    {hasTrait:Cowardly}I hope we can trust him. It's never wise to deal with the dead.
    {hasTrait:Merciful} What a terrible fate. We must set these restless spirits free.
    ->Set those bodies alight. Hopefully it will give the victims some peace.
    <<PlaySound PyrolancerWildfireSpread>>
    <<PlaySound Inferno>>
    {advisor}Let's hope Matilde's mother has not met the same fate.
    **The grim pyre is set. Best move along and away from the greasy smoke.**
    ->Two more to go, then. Come on. **Continue**
        <<UpdateQuestObjectiveText "Burn the bodies (reduces the number of specters)">>
        <<SetEventFinished>>
        <<stop>>

title: SE.HouseOnHillBoss
tags: ScriptedEvent
groupName: ContentUpdateQuests
position: 4763,1557
---
<<set $Icon to "Boss">>
<<CreateNpc "id:houseOnHillBoss,name:Halldor,img:npc_male_hostile">>
**The guttering glow of a dozen rushlights limns a bizarre scene, a ramshackle alchemist's laboratory in the middle of a dripping cave. The walls of the chamber are lined with cages holding misshapen figures that no longer appear human--subjects of whatever twisted experiments are being performed here. A robed man looks up with a surprised grunt, setting down a ceramic flask he was fiddling with. His dark hood seems to obscure a badly disfigured face, matching characteristics commonly seen among the Blighted.**
{npc:houseOnHillBoss}What's this? Why do you interrupt my work?
->Your work? You've murdered scores of innocents. That cannot go unanswered. **Attack**
    <<ShowParty>>
    <<CreateBossEncounter HouseOnHill>>
    <<SetPostBattleEvent SE.HouseOnHillBossPostCombat>>
    <<ModifyBossName "Halldor">>
    <<ModifyBossTraits "Reckless,Thorns,Healer">>
    <<stop>>
->What in Caelum have you done, you madman?
    {npc:houseOnHillBoss}You storm into my laboratory, interrupt my important work, and question me? But I can see you're confused. I am a researcher, not a murderer. **He lowers his hood, revealing his disturbing features in full.** I need these travelers to further my experiments with the Blight. 
    {npc:houseOnHillBoss}I am working slowly towards a cure, you see. **He taps a thick journal on his work station.** I take little joy in bloodshed, but the nature of these experiments required some... sacrifice. 
    {player:0}He has the Blight, of course. That's why he looks so ravaged.
    <<if checkForJob("Scholar") == "true">>
        **The man eyes your party and settles his gaze on [$CharacterWithJobName].**
        {npc:houseOnHillBoss}You there! You look rather learned. Would you not agree my work is of utmost importance?
        {player:$CharacterWithJob}Not in this manner, no. 
        {npc:houseOnHillBoss}Then you are a fool--but you'll make a fine test subject.
    <<else>>
        {npc:houseOnHillBoss}Indeed. And you'll all make fine test subjects!
    <<endif>>
    <<if isTempAllyAlive("houseOnHillVanguard") is "true">>
        {npc:houseOnHillVanguard}His journal may be useful to the Circle, but he cannot be allowed to live.
    <<else>>
        {advisor}His journal may prove useful to someone, but we don't need him alive for that.
    <<endif>>
    ->Your experiments end now! **Attack**
        <<ShowParty>>
        <<CreateBossEncounter HouseOnHill>>
        <<SetPostBattleEvent SE.HouseOnHillBossPostCombat>>
        <<ModifyBossName "Halldor">>
        <<ModifyBossTraits "Reckless,Thorns,Healer">>
        <<stop>>

title: SE.HouseOnHillCaptives

<<set $Icon to "Unknown">>
<<CreateNpc "id:houseOnHillCaptive1,name:Captive Woman,img:npc_female_friendly">>
<<CreateNpc "id:houseOnHillCaptive2,name:Captive Man,img:npc_male_friendly">>
<<if $HouseOnHillBossKilled is "false">>
    <<if $HouseOnHillFoundCaptives is "false">>
        **As your companions try to ease the tension with a few jokes, you hear voices up ahead calling out. You turn the corner to find two people locked up in a cage that is barely big enough to hold them.**
        {npc:houseOnHillCaptive1}Thank the gods! Please, get us out of here before that madman comes back!
        <<if getCharacterWithTrait("Cautious,Treacherous") == "true">> 
            {hasTrait:Cautious}And how do we know you're not dangerous?
            {npc:houseOnHillCaptive2}Do we look dangerous?
            {advisor}Hardly.
        <<endif>> 
        <<if checkForJob("Picklock") == "true">>
            ->[RemoveRequiredItem:tio_tools,Time:5]Get them out of there, [$CharacterWithJobName]. **Pick the lock with tools**
                {player:$CharacterWithJob}Yes, [myTitle].
                **With more difficulty than expected, [$CharacterWithJobName] finally picks the lock and opens up the cage.**
                <<PlaySound UnlockWithKey>> 
                <<AddCitizenToGuildOpinion closest 20>>
                {npc:houseOnHillCaptive2}Thank you! I don't think we would have lasted much longer...
                ->What happened to you?
                {npc:houseOnHillCaptive2}A few days ago we spent the night in the house above. A man came out of nowhere, overpowered us, and dragged us down here. When we came to we were locked up in this cage. 
                {npc:houseOnHillCaptive1}There was another woman with us, but she was taken elsewhere almost immediately. We heard screams...
                ->Was her name Irini?
                **She nods slowly.**
                {npc:houseOnHillCaptive1}We fear she's dead. We'd be next, were it not for you.
                {advisor}Let's hope she isn't. Her daughter asked us to find her.
                **The woman fishes in her garments for a moment and pulls out a small necklace.**
                {npc:houseOnHillCaptive1}Then you should take this. It came off her as she struggled against that monster. 
                <<ModifyGlobalVar $HouseOnHillMothersNecklaceFound "true">>
                <<CreateItem "itm_houseOnHillNecklace" "Irini's Necklace" "A modest, yet valuable necklace." "600">>
                <<GiveQuestItem itm_houseOnHillNecklace>>
                {npc:houseOnHillCaptive2}If there's nothing else, I think it's time we leave. I don't want to spend another minute down here. **With a soft smile, the man places a gentle hand on your arm.** Thank you again. I do hope you find her.
                ->**Continue**
                    <<SetEventFinished>>
                    <<stop>>
            ->Can you open it, [$CharacterWithJobName]? **Try to pick the lock**
                **[$CharacterWithJobName] inspects the lock and gives it a go to no avail.**
                {player:$CharacterWithJob}No good, boss. Without the proper tools, I'm afraid only a specific key will open this. And I suppose magic is out of the question?
                {advisor}Aye. Too risky.
                {npc:houseOnHillCaptive1}There's a man down here. He has the key.
                ->You've seen him?
                {npc:houseOnHillCaptive1}Enough of him to know what type of monster he is.
                {npc:houseOnHillCaptive2}A few days ago we spent the night in the house above. He came out of nowhere, overpowered us, and dragged us down here. When we came to we were locked up in this cage. 
                {npc:houseOnHillCaptive1}There was another woman with us, but she was taken elsewhere almost immediately. We heard screams...
                ->Was her name Irini?
                **She nods slowly.**
                {npc:houseOnHillCaptive1}We fear she's dead. 
                {advisor}Let's hope she isn't. Her daughter asked us to find her.
                **The woman fishes in her garments for a moment and pulls out a small necklace, handing it to you through the iron bars.**
                {npc:houseOnHillCaptive1}Then you should take this. It came off her as she struggled against that monster. 
                <<ModifyGlobalVar $HouseOnHillMothersNecklaceFound "true">>
                <<CreateItem "itm_houseOnHillNecklace" "Irini's Necklace" "A modest, yet valuable necklace." "600">>
                <<GiveQuestItem itm_houseOnHillNecklace>>
                ->We'll return with the key. 
                {npc:houseOnHillCaptive2}Good luck. We'll await your return.
                ->**Continue**
                    <<ModifyGlobalVar $HouseOnHillFoundCaptives "true">>
                    <<stop>>
        <<else>>
            ->Hold on, we'll get you out.
                **Your party inspects the lock, each taking a turn at opening it, but without a proper lockpick among you or a key, it seems impossible for you to open.**
                {player:0}No good, boss. I'm afraid only a specific key will open this. And I suppose magic is out of the question?
                {advisor}Aye. Too risky.
                {npc:houseOnHillCaptive1}There's a man down here. He has the key.
                ->You've seen him?
                {npc:houseOnHillCaptive1}Enough of him to know what type of monster he is.
                {npc:houseOnHillCaptive2}A few days ago we spent the night in the house above. He came out of nowhere, overpowered us, and dragged us down here. When we came to we were locked up in this cage. 
                {npc:houseOnHillCaptive1}There was another woman with us, but she was taken elsewhere almost immediately. We heard screams...
                ->Was her name Irini?
                **She nods slowly.**
                {npc:houseOnHillCaptive1}We fear she's dead. 
                {advisor}Let's hope she isn't. Her daughter asked us to find her.
                **The woman fishes in her garments for a moment and pulls out a small necklace, handing it to you through the iron bars.**
                {npc:houseOnHillCaptive1}Then you should take this. It came off her as she struggled against that monster. 
                <<ModifyGlobalVar $HouseOnHillMothersNecklaceFound "true">>
                <<CreateItem "itm_houseOnHillNecklace" "Irini's Necklace" "A modest, yet valuable necklace." "600">>
                <<GiveQuestItem itm_houseOnHillNecklace>>
                ->We'll return with the key. 
                {npc:houseOnHillCaptive2}Good luck. We'll await your return.
                ->**Continue**
                    <<ModifyGlobalVar $HouseOnHillFoundCaptives "true">>
                    <<stop>>
        <<endif>>
    <<else>>
        {npc:houseOnHillCaptive1}You're back! Did you get the key?
        ->Not yet. We'll be back. **Continue**
            <<stop>>
    <<endif>>
<<else>>
    <<if $HouseOnHillFoundCaptives is "true">>
        {npc:houseOnHillCaptive1}You're back! Did you get the key?
        ->We did.
        **Stepping toward the cage, [FNameP0] twists the key into the lock which opens with a creak.**
        <<PlaySound UnlockWithKey>>
        <<AddCitizenToGuildOpinion closest 20>>
        {npc:houseOnHillCaptive1}Thank you! I take it that madman is dead?
        **You nod in confirmation and relief washes over their faces.**

title: node.DaggerForDridgeKnifeHaggle
tags:

---
<<if checkForJob("Scholar") == "true">>
    {player:$CharacterWithJob}We were given 40 gold pieces to make the purchase, but my research tells me it's worth much more.

        <<PlaySound LootItems>>
        <<ModifyGold -10>>
        <<GiveQuestItem itm_DridgeKrisKnife>>
        ->We'll be on our way. **Continue**
            <<UpdateQuestObjective Quest.DaggerForDridge primary success "Return to Dridge in [questTown].">>
            <<stop>>
    ->[CheckGold:40]Forty gold pieces. **Offer 40[coin]**
        {npc:dridgeBanditNpc}Look at Master Big Britches throwing their gold around like grains of rice! I wonder how much more you've got in them purses o' yours.
        {npc:dridgeBandit2Npc}Why don't we give 'em a shake and see what drops out, eh?
        ->**Fight**
            <<ModifyGlobalVar $DridgeKrisKnifeFought "true">>
            <<ShowPartyOnRegionTileset SE.DridgeKrisKnifeBattle>>
    ->[CheckGold:100]One hundred gold pieces. And at that price, I'm not haggling further. **Offer 100[coin]**
        {npc:dridgeBanditNpc}Look at Master Big Britches throwing their gold around like grains of rice! I wonder how much more you've got in them purses o' yours.
